description:
Located in Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museums, theaters, concert halls and cinemas, this duplex unit is waiting to welcome its new guests. It is within walking distance to places such as Taksim, Şişli and Nişantaşı.

High speed Wi-Fi available.
Elevator, parking, 24/7 security, reception.
New & High quality furniture.
You can enjoy cityview from your balcony and terrace.
Please kindly check all photos for details.

Wish you experience a wonderful stay HERE !

reviews.text:
Guest Teori in Istanbul definitely delivered.
The apartment was stylish, comfortable, and very clean — exactly what I was hoping for.
The host & team were friendly, helpful, and quick to respond to any questions, making everything easy and stress-free. The location was ideal near Taksim and not far by transit to all the main sights, yet quiet enough to relax after a busy day. I’d definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul

Nihan is a great host. She arranged early check-in for us. It really made things easier after a 12h flight with two young kids. Her staff and front desk team were very friendly and helpful. We used to stay at the Sheraton Hotel right next door, but this airbnb is so much more spacious. We will definitely stay again and recommend to our friends.
Loved staying at guest teori’s place super clean and had everything I needed. Nihan was really nice and helpful 👍

Le logement proposé était propre et de bons standing. La communication avec notre hôte était parfaite. Elle a pu organiser notre check in tardif sans problème. Le logement était spacieux avec une superbe terrasse et un lave-linge, ce qui était pratique pour la famille. En revanche, le logement était situé un peu loin des centres d’intérêt, mais cela n’est pas vraiment problématique avec les transports en commun.
Amazing place, security is available. Location is great.

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally located location.

reviews.text: Konum olarak harika bir yerde. Bütün turistik yerlere yakın ve ulaşım çok rahat. Ev ise fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibi temiz ve hoştu. Bence bu fiyata harika bir yer. Tam bir fiyat performans! Ev sahipleri de sorularıma hızlıca cevap verdiler. Genel olarak çok memnun kaldım. Her şey için teşekkürler ☺️

The apartment was very clean, and a great size for 1-2 people. While there’s no kitchen amenities, a fridge was all that I really needed. The neighborhood might seem a little odd, but I actually really liked being in the middle of the local action. It was really close walking to many things including the T1 tram. Lots of little stores nearby. They were really responsive, and I had a great week staying there!

Good location with quick access to everything you will ever need. The area is very local, with tea, coffee and breakfast right under the apartment. The area is very lively so you may expect some street noise as it is normal in Istanbul. The apartment very clean and comfy. Host very friendly.

tam anlamıyla dört dörtlük bir konaklama geçirdik. konum olarak beyazıt tramvaylara 5 dklık bir yokuş. çevresi biraz kalabalık ve esnaf yoğunluklu. pek güven vermiyor çevresi. bina kolay bulunur ve girişi kolay. kimseyle muhattap olmadan direkt kutudan anahtar alınıyor ve giriş sağlanıyor. evin içi 20 metrekare kadar ve tatlı bi daire. temizliği on numaraydı. istanbul gezisi yapmak isteyen çiftler için tam fiyat performans ve hallice ucuz bi yer. ev sahiplerine temizlik ve iletişim için çok teşekkür ederiz..

Ev sahibi giriş için esneklik sağladı. Sorularıma hızlı ve çözüm odaklı cevaplar verildi. Fakat ev fotoğraflarda daha büyük görünüyordu. En büyük sorun olarak perdenin kapanmıyor olmasıydı çok zorlandık ve kendimizce kısmen çözüm bulduk. Bunun dışında konum ve temizlik iyiydi. Ekstra ütü de koymuşlardı isteğim üzerine çok teşekkürler.

description: Welcome to my home in the heart of Kadıköy, a modern apartment with a view in the historical Yeldeğirmeni district. Situated in a lively area, my home offers a perfect blend of comfort and coziness, providing an enjoyable Istanbul experience. This place, just a few minutes away from bustling markets, cozy cafes, and all public transportation types , is an ideal starting point for your Istanbul adventure.

reviews.text: It was an okay stay, good location as it's between the Metro and Kakikoy and about 15 min taxi ride to most other attractions. There is definitely someone living there though in-between stays which was fine considering the lower price. It was fine for a week as I didn't spend much time in the room.

This is now my favorite apartment in Istanbul that I have stayed in over the past 5 years. The most convenient location that can be. There is a bus stop near the house, 10 minutes to the pier and metro, 20 minutes to the train station. There are so many cafes and restaurants in the area around the house. The apartment is cozy, has everything you need. Suitable for long term stay. I will definitely stay here again.
We had a 10-day stay and we loved it in this apartment. The host was very attentive and helpful.

good but not recomended this place for who really care about the clean house
but burak is a nice person and I really respect him
Herşey iyiydi, biraz daha temiz olabilirdi.

description:
Discover the perfect blend of convenience and tranquility at our centrally-located studio, nestled between Sisli, Taksim, and Nisantasi in the heart of Istanbul. Our place offers a peaceful sanctuary where you can unwind and recharge, providing an ideal base for both work and leisure travelers.

Our studio's simplicity and comfort set it apart. With its prime location, you'll have easy access to the vibrant neighborhoods of Sisli, Taksim's bustling scene, and the chic boutiques of Nisantasi.

reviews.text: This was my first visit to Istanbul, and I was initially uncertain about where to stay, as I’m quite particular. However, I was fortunate to find this place. It was exactly as pictured—clean, modern, well-maintained, and conveniently located near public transport and shopping centers. Irfan was welcoming, and everything went smoothly throughout my stay. I highly recommend this spot for anyone looking for a comfortable stay and accessible base in the city.

Erfan is truly one of the best hosts you could hope for; attentive within minutes and always incredibly helpful. I had a great time here that I even extended my stay, and I would gladly return next time. The apartment is located in my favorite district of Istanbul, offering both local charm and easy access to transportation. It’s clean, exactly as shown in the pictures, and made my stay very comfortable.

The apartment was nice and clean, especially the shower was very nice. Everything was as described, there was a washing machine and a dryer, which was great. Furthermore, the street where the apartment is at is very quiet.
However, what made this booking really special, was the host Erfan. He was always available and very helpful. His hospitality was impressive, I felt very comfortable and appreciate his efforts. Definitely to recommend!

I had a pleasant stay at this Airbnb in Istanbul. The flat was small but clean and had everything I needed for a comfortable visit. The location was excellent, with great transport links to the old town and other parts of the city—it made getting around really easy. The host, Erfaan, was very nice and accommodating, which made the experience even better. Overall, a great spot for staying in Istanbul, and I’d definitely recommend it to others.
The place was exactly as described and matched the photos. The location is super with 5 minutes walking to Taxim square and Isteklal street. Very quiet and safe neighborhood. Absolutely recommended.

description: The flat in a historical building and it is on the third floor with steep stairs. No elevator. It is very spacious, well designed and renovated recently. It is exactly same street with Galata Tower.

reviews.text: We had wonderful 5 days in Akif's appartment which is located between Galata tower and Şişhane metro stop. The charming flat is more spacious than it seems from the pictures, we were staying there in three and it was totally fine (the smallest bedroom is really only a slim bed with night stand and you walk through the neighbouring larger bedroom to exit it - totally worked for us though). Small kitchen and one shared bathroom. Great water pressure, good heating in all rooms. Despite the central location and the many tourists around, it was not noisy in the flat. Akif was very friendly and helpful, carried parts of my heavy luggage up the steep stairs to 3rd floor and gave useful advice regarding restaurants in the area. Public transport is easy to reach, but walking around the area is also absolutely worth it. And don't miss watching the sunset from the stairs at Şişhane metro stop! Thanks Akif, we'd definitely come back

Amazing location right by the Galata tower. The apartment was decorated nicely and felt homey. It’s a historic building so you’re paying to experience the location. Lots of stairs to get up to the 3rd floor apartment. If you can’t carry your luggage/suitcase comfortably, you will struggle going up and down.
The apartment is spacious and can fit many people. At the price point, I would consider visiting again with my friends.
The bathroom needs to be updated. The sliding shower doors don’t connect so there is water all over the floor every time someone uses it. The shower was also leaky.
The bed linens had a few stains so I think they need to be updated. I could tell it was washed, it was just stained so in my opinion needs to be replaced.
The A/C was very old and loud. It didn’t cool the living room down so we opted to leave windows open. Thankfully there was a breeze.
Host was responsive and polite. Met us at the door and helped us get in. Answered our texts.

We had a great time in this apartment! It seemed a bit smaller than in the photos, but four adults were perfectly comfortable there for three days and felt at home.
Pros: The location is excellent — just one block from the Galata Tower, close to the metro and within walking distance of the funicular, which made getting around very easy. Akif was a great host: always in touch, quick to help, met us personally, gave us a tour of the apartment and agreed to a slightly later checkout. The apartment has everything you might need, from clean bedding to kitchen utensils, and it was very warm inside with an adjustable thermostat. The interior is stylish and thoughtfully renovated despite the historic building, and we really appreciated the design touches.
Cons: One bedroom faces a very noisy street, and on weekends it can be loud until 3 a.m. There were also a couple of minor issues: a leaky shower faucet and some dust
Overall, the flat is ideal for 4 adults for a short stay. Thnx Akif!

The apartment was perfect for 3 people. Great location for sightseeing and being in the heart of it all - there is a lot to see and do within 30 - 40 minutes walking distance - including many of the main attractions, ferries, lots of cafes, restaurants and shops.
Akif was really helpful and responded to any questions.
The apartment was clean and tastefully decorated - really comfortable beds and a great shower.
It's so good to walk straight out of the front door onto a busy vibrant street, but also not hear much of it once you're up the stairs and in the apartment.
We had a brilliant holiday and would thoroughly recommend staying here. Thank you!

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is spacious, beautifully designed, and full of character. Every detail is thoughtfully planned, creating a cozy and authentic atmosphere.
Akif kindly allowed us to check in early, which was very helpful because my sister had to work online. He also gave us great recommendations for cafés and restaurants.
Two bedrooms overlook a quiet courtyard. The third faces a lively tourist street, but thanks to the high floor and closed window at night, it was quiet and comfortable for sleeping.
The location is perfect, just one minute from Galata Tower, with many cafés and restaurants nearby. The kitchen is well equipped. The staircase is quite steep.
We traveled with my almost 70-year-old mother, and she managed it well after the first day. However, it may be challenging for guests with young children or limited mobility.
Akif's assistant welcomed us, helped with luggage, and explained everything.
Highly recommended!

description:
Your Comfortable and Central Home in Istanbul
Centrally located, very close to public transportation, metro and buses are within walking distance. We would love to welcome you to our apartment in the secure residence site. It is very easy to get to the shopping malls. The apartment has all the ingredients for food and shelter. The site has heating, hot water, internet and city views. The site also has an Olympic pool. Book now for an unforgettable Istanbul experience!

reviews.text: After a long day of travel, staying in this apartment was exactly what I needed, super comfortable, clean, contains everything you need (kitchen utensils, washing machine, dishwasher, etc.), and all things are new and very well cared for. The view from the apartment is the most amazing, you can see the whole city, at night the city lights became a spectacle from the window. The internet is super fast, the apartment is quiet, great for those who work online just like me. The location of the apartment is excellent, close to the airport, shopping mall, metro, markets, etc. Second was super attentive and always available if we needed something. I really recommend this apartment and I will definitely come back again.

13–20 Mayıs tarihleri arasında konakladık. Yurtiçi ve yurtdışında birçok Airbnb deneyimi olan biri olarak yaziyorum. Onur Bey iletişim konusunda yardımcı ve ulaşılabilir biri. Evde birçok eşya mevcut ve güvenlikli site içinde olması avantajlı. Ancak Metro mesafesi ilanda belirtildiği gibi 5 dk değil, yürüyerek yaklaşık 10–15 dk sürüyor. Fotoraflardaki market yok kapanmış, bakimli değil yıpranmış bir ev. En büyük problem ise kesinlikle koku. Yorumlarda yazıldığı kadardan fazlası var ve hiçbir şekilde hijyenik hissettirmiyor. Lavabolar tabaklarla kapanmış duşa kabin giderine de su doldurulmuş poşet konulmuş kokuyu bastirmak için. Çıkmamiza birkaç saat kala mutfak tarafında böcek görmek de hiç iyi olmadı. Yatak ve yastık çok rahatsız uyunacak gibi değil. Tv kumandası calismiyor. Banyo kapısı asla sabit durmuyor, çarpıyor. imkanlar kullanılamadığından ve rahatsiz edici seyler nedeniyle fiyatı kesinlikle karşılamiyor. Önermiyorum.

Lovely apartment, Onur was waiting for me at the entrance, security card to access the apartments, 24 hour security, the apartment was clean, comfortable and quiet. Internet was perfect for my work, kitchen had everything I needed, bed was comfy, I really enjoyed my stay.
Carrefour supermarket adjoining which was super handy. 2 metro stations within walking distance, Ataturk Cd had shops, restaurants, and just a 5 min walk. There is a small cafe next to the pool which was nice to sit in the sunshine, so peaceful. I would recommend this apartment and would definitely stay again.

We stayed in this apartment for 5 nights and had a great experience. The apartment was very clean, had everything we needed and it was very easy to walk to the metro station. All of the amenities listed were included, which made our stay carefree and easy.
We were travelling with our cat and the place is very pet friendly, which made our time even more comfortable. I would recommend this place if you’re travelling with your pet! ^^
The host responded to questions very quickly and was very kind, which we really appreciated.
The only issue (which was mentioned in other reviews) is sometimes there is a very strong sulphur smell from the drains but this is not the fault of the host and normally only lasts a short time.
We would definitely stay here again and recommend this apartment to others ^^

Apartment in close proximity to airport. Nice and secure place (own security guards). Beautiful view from the windows. Convenient store just near the entrance of house.
Apartment itself is clean, all things washed and cleaned. Trash can on the floor, no need to go outside. Warm inside even without turning on the heater.
Owner is nice, answering quickly even in late time. Was no problem for me to get inside an apartment even after 20:00.
Things that some people may find inconvenient:
1. At least two mosques near the building. It can wake you up early in the morning and ringing throughout the day.
2. Some of the kitchen cabinets is hard to open (some even stuck to the wall).
3. Sometimes there is bad smell from under the sink in kitchen.
4. TV is cheap, can be difficult to stream from the phone or laptop onto it (maybe because connected to wifi, not wired). Lagging in general.
Overall I had a great experience living in that apartment and had a beautiful time in Istanbul. Thank you, Onur!

description:
This apartment is in the most central location. I'll be happy to help you as I live in the apartment downstairs. I share the distances to central and important places
Metrobus & Marmaray 12 mins' walk
Bar street 2 mins' walk
Coffee shops and restaurants (everywhere)
Seaside & metro 8 mins walk

reviews.text:
The apartment is ideally located just a 15-minute walk from the Kadıköy bus and metro station, in a vibrant area filled with cafes, vintage stores, and popular hangout spots. It offers all the essentials for a comfortable stay, and communication with Sevkan was quick and efficient. For its price, it truly represents great value.
That said, I would like to mention a few areas for improvement. The apartment was not as clean as expected, particularly the bathroom, and I found a small screwdriver on the floor, which could have posed a safety risk. Additionally, the entrance is partially blocked by the shop downstairs, which can be a bit inconvenient at times. The noise level at night can also be quite high, so I would recommend bringing earplugs for a more peaceful sleep.

Sevkan and his friend were both greatly helpful with communications, and the apartment was exactly where I wanted to be.
However, cleanliness wasn't great - for example there were hairs in the bathroom sink, mildew in the shower cubicle and dirt on the window handle. Most disturbingly, when I found the duvet, it had a blood stain on it.
The sofa had cigarette burns on it, the stool provided was covered in paint stains and the rickety wooden clothes frame was about to fall apart (it had already broken in several places).
Navigating the way up to the apartment was tricky due to a shop putting their wares in front of the ground floor door every day, and clutter on the stairwell and badly timed automatic lights making the stairs quite dangerous.
However the apartment was reasonably priced and I suppose that you get what you pay for.

We had a great week at Sevkans place. The flat was as described and is the perfect location for exploring Istanbul! The flat was clean and we could use the couch as a second bed. The communication was quick and easy. On the weekend it can get a bit louder on the streets but when the windows are closed it does not affect you :) yes, the bathroom may be small but for us it was more then enough. The shower has a lot of space. Great place if you want to explore Kadiköy.
Thank you!

Sevkan's place is as described. There is a loving room area with the kitched and a bedroom / bathroom area. Sufficient space for a solo travelor or couple. The location is conveniently located in Kadikoy. It is on a busy street with many restaurants. There is a little street noise, but nothing major. And it is a non-issue with ear plugs.
The room is tucked away in a building with shops on the first floor. You have to walk up three flights of stairs.
Sevkan is very response to communications and flexible. A great host.

I had a great stay at Sevkan’s place in Kadıköy. The location is very central, making it easy to get around and explore the area. The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. Sevkan was a helpful and responsive host. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul!

description:
• 1+1 apartment with a view in Florya Şenlikköy
• Comfortable bedroom, spacious living room and fully equipped kitchen
• Fast Wi-Fi, Netflix, air conditioning and natural gas boiler
• Within walking distance of Florya Beach, Şenlikköy Forest, markets, cafes and restaurants
• 24-hour security and a café offering breakfast, tea, and coffee service
• Ideal for couples, small families and business trips

***There are 3 apartments with exactly the same size and features (1 entrance, 2 on the first floor); the apartment is allocated based on availability.***

reviews.text: Casa Florya’da konaklamamız gerçekten çok konforluydu. Oda son derece temizdi ve fotoğraflarla birebir aynıydı. Sıcak su ve ısıtma sorunsuz çalışıyordu. Tesiste 24 saat açık resepsiyon olması büyük bir güven sağlıyor. Sabah sunulan kahvaltı da oldukça yeterli ve lezzetliydi, bu da konaklamayı daha rahat hale getirdi. Konum sakin ve güvenli bir bölgede, ulaşım açısından da çok kolay. Check-in süreci hızlı ve profesyoneldi. Hem ev rahatlığı hem butik otel hizmeti bir arada sunuluyor. İstanbul’a tekrar geldiğimizde yine tercih ederiz.

I had a fantastic stay at this apartment. The location was perfect, with supermarkets, restaurants, a metro station, bus stops, pharmacies, shops, a kids' playground, a lovely park, and cozy coffee spots all within walking distance. The apartment itself was newly furnished, spotlessly clean, and had all the amenities I needed. Ibrahim, the receptionist, was incredibly helpful and flexible throughout my stay, making sure everything went smoothly. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient stay. Would definitely book again!

Nice place, the only 2 small inconvenients were lack of separation between the bedroom and the living room, also the central heating would either provide scorching hot water or freezing cold, so that would be best to be fixed
The neighborhood is nice and quiet, the beach is at 1.7km away, nearby public transportation stations. We liked it a lot

Yer olarak güzel bir konumdaydı.Yürüyüşe gidip dolaşılacak alışveriş merkezlerine yakın mesafedeydi.Temizlik olarak orta durumdaydı.Çarsaf havlular oda temizdi salondaki koltuk biraz bakıma temizliğe ihtiyacı var.Mutfakta ihtiyaç olan birçok gereç mevcuttu.Sıcak suyu tesisat olarak yanlış bağlamışlar.İlk gün anlamadık soğuk su ile duş aldık.Arayıp bildirdiğimizde hızlı dönüş yaptılar ve ihtiyaç olarak ne istediysek anında yardımcı oldular.Genel olarak memnun kaldığımız konaklamaydı.
Florya da merkezi konumda heryere yakın. Yeni bir bina ve odalar yeni. Ailece konakladık. Temiz, güvenilir ve ferah bir mekan. Çalışanlar her hususta yardımcı oluyorlar. Fiyat ve olanakları çok iyi.

description:
You can stay in the center of Kadıköy and easily reach anywhere in Istanbul thanks to its accessibility to all public transportation options.

Our centrally located home comes with fiber internet and all-inclusive household items. You can also enjoy a peaceful balcony overlooking trees.

Every detail is designed for your comfort and convenience. Unlike many old buildings in Kadıköy, you can stay in a new and elevator-equipped building, within walking distance to cafes, bars, shops, and cinemas.

reviews.text: The balcony offers a stunning view, which would be amazing in summer. However, Istanbul in May is still too cold. The air conditioner isn’t effective, the quilt is thin, and we really don’t want to do laundry in the room. The hot water is unstable and hard to adjust to a comfortable temperature. While it’s not nearly as clean as a hotel, it’s acceptable for a homestay. The location is excellent, with easy access to piers, buses, and subway stations. Communication is smooth, check-in is self-service, and the landlord is nice. Additionally, the room has poor soundproofing—the noise mainly comes from other rooms, not the street.

The place was as described and in pictures. There were a few hiccups which Bahat responded to immediately. As a host he could not enough for us. The location was perfect. All forms of transportation were within 5 minutes walking distance. This made it easy to access both the European and Asian side of Istanbul easily. All amenities were provided to the extent of shower gel, toothpaste, washing powder and conditioner for the washing machine, tea, coffee etc.
Finally, if the host is great then everything else will run smoothly. Bahat was superb throughout.

The neighborhood is peaceful, very close to bazaar, bull statue, bus stop, metro and ferry are at walkable distance. The house was perfect. Dilan has paid attention to all the requirements that travellers need. Iron box, Hair dryer, Washing machine, Washing powder, Clothes rack, Crockery, Cutlery, Spices, Olive oil, Sugar, Coffee powder, Clean Towels and Bedsheet, Blanket, WiFi everything is provided. Balcony is cozy and I enjoyed the stay thoroughly. I will definitely come again. Very thoughtful and proactive host. I felt like home. Thank you so much 👍🏼

Bahat was a great host, very welcoming and easy to communicate with. The apartment was exactly what we were expecting: cozy, clean, and in a great location. Even though it’s right in the heart of Kadıköy, it was surprisingly quiet. The temperature inside was perfect, which made the stay very comfortable. The only thing to note is that the mattress is quite hard, which may or may not suit everyone. Overall, a very pleasant stay and a place we’d happily recommend.

Bahat was very responsive, answered my questions in maximum 10 minutes. And Bahat’s manner was very kind. The flat was exactly like how it was described and it was very clean and well organized. Very central location, close to so many restaurants, cafes etc.

description:
Nestled in the heart of vibrant Karakoy, newly renovated studio units offer the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience for your stay in Istanbul.

Step outside and find yourself immersed in the vibrant energy of Karakoy. Indulge in a variety of cafes, restaurants, and shops just steps away from your door. Galataport is within 5 min walking distance.

Allowing you to easily explore Istanbul's rich history and vibrant culture.

Passport/ID info to the host during check-in bylaw

reviews.text: This apartment was perfect for my first solo holiday and it is in a perfect position in Karakoy, a 5 min walk to the ferry pier and 10 mins to the tram; close to many cafes, bars, restaurants and a small supermarket. Only short walks to many of Istanbul’s sites. I felt safe everywhere I went. There is a small view of the Bosporus to the left and the top of Galata Tower to the right although I would say it’s not a sitting out balcony. There is some outside noise but it’s a bustling city and didn’t disturb me. Communication with was brilliant and access very well described. One big bonus is the lift up to the 4th floor - only one apartment on each floor so very quiet. Good shower, great a/c, comfy bed and everything I needed. Definitely recommended and I would stay there again.
Great stay! The apartment is exactly as shown in the photos, very clean and ideally located. The host was very responsive and kind. I highly recommend it!

I stayed at Ekin’s place for 14 days and felt genuinely welcomed from arrival to departure. Ekin was attentive, responsive, and went above and beyond to ensure a comfortable stay every question was answered promptly and with care.
The location is simply unbeatable. Situated in the heart of Istanbul, the apartment is steps from the tram and bus stations, with easy access to the ferry to the Asian Side. World-class landmarks the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and the Basilica Cistern are all within walking distance.
The balcony view is a highlight in itself: a breathtaking outlook over the Galata Tower and the Karaköy Ferry Terminal home to the now-famous street corn vendor Alper, whose charm has captured hearts across social media just two minutes on foot from the unit.
My ratings:
• 📍 Location: 5/5
• 🔒 Safety: 5/5
• ✨ Cleanliness: 5/5
• 🤝 Host Hospitality: 5/5
Ekin’s place will be my home base every time I return to Istanbul.
Merci!

We really enjoyed our stay! It was within walking distance to all the sights we wanted to see and close to public transport for the further destinations.
The accomodation itself was beautiful! It was super clean and had everything that we needed. It was our last place we stayed on our trip and it was the most comfortable!
The check-in instructions were clear and when we arrived, we were met with someone who showed us to our apartment and offered us help.
We had to leave a day earlier than our booking due to a change of flight and we had notified Shortzi Management just so they could clean the apartment earlier if they wanted to advertise and potentially get someone else in and they ended up giving us a refund for the last day.
We weren’t expecting that at all and so it was a really nice gesture by them. We definitely recommend this place!

The location of the accommodation is excellent and very convenient. The place is well organized and comfortable. We noticed the accommodation need some improvement for cleaning special the additional bedding had some stains and hair, and the floor could use a bit more attention in terms of cleanliness. The host was very kind, helpful, and provided great service. Thank you for the pleasant stay.

description: Luxury apartment in a young and reliable building near the Metro station in Etiler, close to shopping centers, Istanbul's best restaurants and entertainment centers, adjacent to the Bosphorus, in a safe location with easy access to Istanbul's attractions. Sit back and relax in this quiet, stylish place.

reviews.text:
We stayed for almost a month and a half in this one‑bedroom apartment. It was very quiet, extremely clean, and had fast internet. We really enjoyed the location — close to the metro, bus stops, grocery stores, small restaurants, Migros, A101, and even a liquor store. You don’t need a car here; you can get anywhere easily by bus or metro.
The host was very responsive to every question we had. I definitely recommend this place for both short and long stays.
Everything was wonderful: Murat is very responsive and helpful; the apartment is clean, warm, and comfortable; the location is excellent.
Murat’s place was clean and in a good location! The only problem we had which for us was a big one was the AC was not working and it got really hot in the evenings.

I spent two weeks at Murat's place. The apartment is located in a nice neighborhood in Etiler, close proximity to the metro and other transportation. It is walking distance to cafes and restaurants and supermarkets. A convenient store with basic items is right outside the building. Murat was very responsive, helpful whenever I had questions and although his English was limited, we managed to communicate just fine. The apartment is very cute, with lots of light in a quiet neighborhood. I would suggest to add a small table in the living room to be able to use it for work or for putting a drink. The kitchen has the basic essentials but could use more items, especially for people who want to stay for a long period. Overall, I was very happy with my stay and I would highly recommend Murat's place.

I really enjoyed my stay here! The apartment is new, clean, and beautifully maintained. It has such good energy, very comfortable and cozy. The location is amazing, close to everything you might need. I would definitely stay here again.

description: Next to the Süleymaniye Mosque, it is within walking distance of historical buildings such as the Grand Bazaar, Sultan Ahmet Mosque, Eminönü, Hagia Sophia Mosque and Galata Tower. You can easily get around Istanbul as it is within walking distance of the tram and metro stations.

reviews.text: Ibrahim is a very nice host, and we had very good communication. The house was very clean as shown in the pictures. , the TV works very well and was connected to the internet and the bathroom was also clean as the pictures. There was metro stations in 5 minutes and bus/ tram stops in 10 minutes, which made transportation easy. Great location within walking distance of the metro, tram, shops, and the beautiful Süleymaniye Mosque. The apartment is clean, well-equipped, and everything works perfectly. Ibrahim Hakki is very friendly and responsive. Self check-in and check-out were easy. Highly recommended — just like the photos!

The apartment was the same as in the photos. It was clean. Some minor issues we faced at first but Ibrahim was very quick to respond and helped us almost immediately after we texted him. Ibrahim was always super friendly, hospitable and helpful during the entire stay. The area was really nice and also filled with inexpensive cafes and shops to eat at. We enjoyed our stay a lot. Thank you Ibrahim!

Great location and very comfortable stay. The apartment is only about 5 minutes from the metro and tram, and around a 15-minute walk to the Bosphorus. The place is modern, clean, and well-equipped with everything you might need during your stay.

The apartment was very spacious and airy. Very clean. Walking distance from attractions. Very close to metro station.
Ibrahim is very responsive. He replies to any queries promptly.
The bed and sofa bed is very comfy.
would recommend this place to anyone who is looking to stay in istanbul.

description:
Our apartment is in the city center, touristic places are within walking distance.
A peaceful apartment where you will feel like you are in your room, touristic places, train station, tram, bus stop are very close by, the location is in a safe area, restaurants, cafes, supermarkets are only 2 minutes away by walk, the apartment has everything you need including air conditioning, microwave, Netflix, I would be happy to help you, our valued guests.
apartment 35 m2

reviews.text:
The host arranged airport transfer at a good price. He didn’t want to share the address. He kept saying he’d given it to me already, which he hadn’t. He finally said to look on my airbnb. The address I found there wasn’t the actual address. Very odd. The host has 14 properties so the reviews cover all address, not this necessarily this particular address.
The host met us at air bnb and carried our bags up the two flights of stairs.
The unit was nice and clean and as described, though the bathroom definately needs a deep clean. There was a clump of hair blocking the shower drain.
The shower was nice and heated up instantly and stayed hot.
The kitchen was not well equipped if you plan to do some cooking for yourself. The only utensil, besides cutlery, was a wooden spoon. There were 3 tea bags but no salt, pepper, sugar, coffee or other basics that are usually provided.
Excellent location surrounded by restaurants. A train station at end of street and one stop from Blue Mosque.

We enjoyed our stay here since it was close to the historical mosques and landmarks in Fatih that we were interested in seeing. The hosts were really amazing and allowed flexible check in for us since we had baggage and a tour scheduled for the morning. They were always responsive and checked in on if we needed anything. Very generous as well with gifting Turkish delights and helping carry our bags up and down the stairs during check in and check out. The area surrounding the apartment is very active with different stores and restaurants. I was able to find some nice dresses at a nearby shop as well. The apartment itself was clean and the bed was comfy too!

We so enjoyed staying at Celal’s place. The apartment is exactly as it looks in the pictures. So comfortable so easy to get to. The location is fantastic. We walked everywhere from. Hagia Sophia- to the ferry docks. The neighborhood itself is lots of fun. There are tons of restaurants right downstairs and they have music at night.Celal and his team took really good care of us, including surprising us with Turkish delight and baklava. We just really liked it there and felt really happy and really comfortable and if I could give him a 10 out of five, I would. Also one other thing there actually is a washer and dryer - there are sometimes when we rent places when they say dryer they mean a hang dryer. This is an actual dryer. The only thing I would say that you really need to be aware of is there are steps to get to the apartment and there are steps to go down to the washer and dryer room. It didn’t bother us at all. We will book here again if we return to Istanbul. Thank you Celal !!

I recently stayed in this studio apartment in Istanbul, and it was an amazing experience. The apartment is cozy, modern, and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. The space is well-utilized, with a compact yet fully-equipped kitchen, a comfortable bed, and a nice seating area. The decor is tasteful and adds a touch of charm to the space.
The location is a standout feature—close to major attractions, shops, cafes, and public transportation, making it incredibly easy to explore the city. Despite being in a bustling area, the apartment itself was quiet, offering a peaceful retreat from the lively city atmosphere.
The host was very accommodating and quick to respond to any questions, ensuring a smooth check-in process and a welcoming environment. I’d highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul. It's perfect for solo travelers or couples looking for a convenient and stylish place to stay!

I stayed here with my bestie for our holidays. Celal is super nice, helping us store our luggage before checking in and after checking out. The apartment is clean, with all the facilities we need. And when we went downstairs to do laundry, the two sisters who did laundry there were very helpful and friendly. Celal was also very kind to help us carry our luggage and walked to the nearby stationing with us and gave us recommendations. All in all, we loved our stay here. Thank you! Highly recommended it.

description:
Our luxury hotel-style apartment, located in a peaceful location close to the city's bustle, offers a comfortable stay.

reviews.text:

description: Our facility is centrally located and within walking distance to many tourist attractions (Sultanahmet, Grand Bazaar, Galata Bridge, Taksim, etc.). reviews.text:

Turkish hospitality! ☆☆☆☆☆

Absolutely Perfect Stay! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Every detail was thoughtful, from the blackout curtains to the strong shower pressure. If you want to experience Turkish warmth in a prime location, don’t look further. We’ll definitely return!

The hotel is okay, easy to find and near the bridal street in the neighbourhood Fatih. The hotel staff is amazing. The rooms are being cleaned every day. The receptionist Halil is the best receptionist that we’ve had until now. Very helpful with everything that you need. Polite, friendly and respectful. I recommend the place.

this hotel was perfect for 5 adults. the location was very good as it was near all the major tourist attractions by car. we had an extra double bed that wasn't used as there was more than enough space for all of us in the remaining beds and rooms. the bathrooms and rooms were spotless & modern, as they were cleaned everyday (but the bedding wasn't changed during our 4 nights). each room had its own thermostat that could be adjusted to preference. the receptionist was always willing to help which is good. there was also no smoking anywhere, which was a plus. even though we lived on the ground floor, it felt very safe as there were barriers outside the windows, plus the area felt generally safe. all facilities (restaurants, bakeries, markets, shops etc) are present in the area from walking distance. the hotel was also very hospitable as they refilled free coffee and tea everyday in all the rooms. this hotel is criminally underrated, would 100% recommend to everyone. we will come again.

Great place to stay. Walking distance to tram and bus stations. Very helpful hosts.
Clean rooms and bathrooms.

reviews.text:
Stayed here for more than a month and there are both positives and negatives about this unit though the negatives outweigh the positives in my opinion.
- Location is convenient with 15 minutes walk to Metro and 20 minutes walk to train but it is in a hilly neighborhood, so you have to be going up and down the hill all the time. The sidewalks in the area are very narrow and littered with garbage and cat food. The local mosque is only about 50 meters away which means you will be woken up every day at 6 am with the morning ezan blasting from its loudspeakers.

An occasional unpleasant smell comes through the sink in the kitchen which requires ventilation by opening windows, even in cold days.

Ev temiz ve düzenliydi. İstanbul seyahatlerinizde gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz.
The apartment is spacious and the area is okay.

description: This apartment in the center of Kadıköy is ideally located for your Istanbul trip. The flat is on the 4th floor, but believe me, our comfort is worth it :)

reviews.text: Quiet Modern functional 4th floor walkup apartment on a quiet street just north / easy walking distance to the cool, happening, Moda neighborhood of Kadicöy. Also easy walking distance to the port. So good location to be walking distance to everything, but Just far enough to be in a peaceful, authentic area. Apartment has everything you need: large shower with great water pressure, in unit washer, stable and fast fiber internet connection with the wifi router in the apartment, fine for video calls, desk / table and chairs / workstation, Mini split AC, Fully equipped kitchen, Stainless water boiler / not plastic, comfortable seperate queen bdrm, opening Juliet balcony doors with sky views, bug screens and double pain noise isolating glass. Easy Checkin via code and lockbox. Host is responsive and accommodating. No issues with this place (unless you have issues with walk up building), don't hesitate to book.
Apartment is in central location and as described, host is responsive and willing to help

I had an issue with the internet but Gulay helped me out immediately and the internet was really quick. I totally recommend this place.

Gulay's is a great host, they are responsive. the apt has everything we needed and it was very clean. the neighborhood is beautiful to walk, most importantly it is very close to Kadikoy station and it was so easy to get to and from Sabiha airport, also to ferry.

reviews.text: Fantastic stay in Istanbul! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Great location, quiet but close to everything. The host was very friendly and responsive, with great local tips. Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend!

Cemoli’s place was idealistic. A true character of old town Istanbul with an impressive interior and coziness even with the busy street. The place was as described and very tidy / clean / great amenities. A market is located right on the street for any groceries , drinks etc you may need.
A note for future travelers as mentioned in previous reviews as well. This is not a deterrent as it added the extra charm and adventure to our trip! the apartment is located on a very busy touristy cobble stone street where taxis cannot drive on. If carrying multiple bags of luggage it is quite an adventure to stream through the crowds to get to the side entrance. The apartment is located on the top floor of a 5 story spiral marble staircase with direct roof access which provides the perfect amount of breeze to catch your breath.
10/10 would stay here again as it was very walkable and close to public transportation to get us around the city

When we arrived, the apartment was too warm and the air conditioning didn't function. We notified the host who tried to fix the issue; however he was unable to get the air conditioning to work by the time we left. We didn't open the windows when it cooled down at night because they don't have screens (possible insects coming in), it's noisy, and the air is very polluted. It would have been appropriate for a price adjustment, but we were provided a fan.
The apartment is nice, but as others have mentioned, it's an extremely busy area, lined with restaurants and people taking photograph at all hours. We felt it was the busiest, tourist-packed street in Istanbul. Also be aware that the water is not drinkable. The host provided a 1.5 liter bottle.

The perfect place for a young couple or some friends to visit Istanbul. Beautiful views from the terraces and you can even see the Galata Tower right from the bedroom window. You're right in the action as soon as you walk out of the building, and it's extremely walkable to popular tourist destination.
The kitchen has everything you need to cook some simple meals. The bedroom gets great natural light and is very comfortable. The bathroom is nice and relaxing. Overall a great apartment to stay at, but you probably won't even want to take full advantage of it with how much there is to do right outside.
Cemoli is an excellent host too. Very responsive and gave great recommendations.
Would definitely consider booking again next time I'm in town.

We absolutely loved our stay! ✨ The apartment was beautiful and exactly as pictured, with so much authentic Istanbul charm. Even the five-floor walk-up felt like part of the experience - it was like stepping into a little piece of history.
The patio view was absolutely breathtaking, and the location next to Galata Tower was perfect. Everything was within walking distance - shops, restaurants, cafés, and so many beautiful places to explore. The AC was also a lifesaver during the heat wave!
As huge animal lovers, we especially loved being greeted by the sweetest cat at the entrance every day. I named him Lukum 🐈❤️
The hosts were great, with clear instructions and very flexible check-in and check-out. We felt like sultans during our stay and would definitely come back! 🇹🇷✨

reviews.text: The villa was clean, comfortable and perfect for 12 family members in Istanbul for a week-long wedding celebration. Comfortable bedrooms, each with its own bath. We had a wonderful stay at Duygu’s property in Istanbul. Duygu and her husband were great hosts, very accommodating, responsive, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay.
The property was exactly as described, recently renovated, very clean, and well maintained. It was perfect for our group, with 7 rooms and each room having its own separate bathroom, which made the stay very comfortable. Each room also had air conditioning, which was a big plus.
The location was very convenient and close to the metro station. We also really enjoyed the outdoor seating area in the backyard, especially at night with the nice lighting. The living room was comfortable, and the large kitchen had almost everything we needed.
Overall, this was a great place to stay, and we would definitely recommend it to other groups visiting Istanbul.

Duygu was a brilliant host. She was friendly and quick to respond every time I messaged. It was very nice of her to personally welcome us when we arrived at her place and give us a tour of the house. The kitchen was well stocked with utensils, crockery, cutlery and equipment.
The entire piece was well furnished and the rooms were exactly as in the photos. Linen was clean. There was a nice spot in the backyard for our group to hang out as well as a living room. There was running hot water.
The neighbourhood was quiet and safe. Galata Tower, Istiklal Street, Taksim square and Nisantasi were about a twenty minute walk. There are many restaurants and groceries are available nearby.
All in all, our stay at Duygu's place exceeded our expectations. I would recommend this house to big groups.

reviews.text:

We stayed in the apartment at the end of July, the hottest time. The air conditioner is located in the common area of living room, but it is powerful enough to cool all rooms. It is a common practice in Istanbul to have only one air conditioner.

Host is very hospitable and helpful.

Enjoy your stay in this top-floor penthouse studio featuring a private balcony with sweeping city views. reviews.text:
Our stay was overall pleasant, though there were a few things worth noting.
On the downside, the floor under the bed wasn’t very clean and had some rubbish left behind. The balcony shown in one of the photos seems to be the view rather than the actual balcony itself, which felt a bit misleading. The bathroom had a noticeable mold smell, and there’s no real kitchen—just a fridge and a water boiler, so cooking isn’t possible. The bed, while comfortable, is quite squeaky.
On the positive side, the host was extremely friendly, responsive, and accommodating. They quickly brought us extra items we requested, like balcony chairs and forks that were missing at first. The bed is very comfortable, the location is great—close to lots of cool spots—and when the window is closed, the noise isolation is decent. The balcony offers a nice city view, and the lively street adds charm to the area.
Overall, it’s a convenient place with a great host, ideal for short stays if you don't plan on cooking.

Great Location and Helpful Host, but Needs Maintenance and Deep Cleaning
The location of this apartment is excellent very close to nightclubs, pubs, bars, restaurants, and the metro station. Additionally, the host is truly a resourceful person who is great at solving problems. If the following issues are addressed, this place would be absolutely magnificent:
• Maintenance: The room definitely needs a fresh coat of paint; it doesn't look as clean as it appears in the photos. The balcony also needs a thorough cleaning, and the Air Conditioning unit urgently requires maintenance.
• Hygiene Issues: The linens (bedsheets, duvet covers, and pillowcases) and towels were stained, had hair on them, and did not smell fresh.
• General Cleanliness: I suggest removing the carpet as it looks quite dirty. The nightstands and tables were dusty upon arrival. If there is a cleaning service involved, I have to say they are not doing a good job.

reviews.text:
Our stay in the Saffron House in Balat was a great experience. Everything is exactly as mentioned by Özkan. This place could well be part of a interiour
house design competition. Beautiful details in every room - the wooden ceiling in the living room is gorgeous. The kitchen is big and well equipped. The whole house is very comfortable and very clean. The balcony is a phantastic place to chill-out in the evening, with a great insight into an original turkish neighbourhood and with a view at the Golden Horn. TV was there but we never used it. WIFI is working excellent and there are repeaters in the house. During summer the air condition in both bedrooms is a great add-on. Three bathrooms should also be more than enough for every situation. Özkan is a marvellous host who is always responding promptly on requests. Things you need to consider for your stay are, that the house is in a very lively, mostly conservative but not wealthy neighbourhood with friendly children and families living next door. Özkan pointed out the restaurant Cooklife to us, a great place to start the day with great breakfast and lovely coffee. For our daily routine sightseeing and shopping required in most cases using the bus or taxi. For single travelers the public bus is less than one Euro but requires the Istanbul Card, for families taxi is more convenient and would cost from 3 to 5 Euro (Eminönü/Taksim) in almost all cases. Personally I would highly recommend this place for people who are open for new experiences, who love great design, young urban life and already have some knowledge about the wonderful city of Istanbul. We will be really happy to return to this hidden treasure in Balat.

reviews.text:
We stayed at Mert's place for a week and it was even better than the description and photos. The location is great, 10 mins' walk to the airport bus stop and right next to Taksim Square. There are some hilly streets in the area, but this apartment is only about 50 meters down a hill, so you won't struggle for long :) We were planning on cooking, and from what we saw, it would have been very possible (pots, pans, utensils, dishes, at least one strainer, many Tupperware containers, etc - and they looked to be decent-quality), but the restaurants nearby were so delicious and cheap, that we mostly ate out.
We met Mert when we arrived and he seemed extremely helpful and genuine. He checked in (via message) every couple days to see if we needed anything, and we could tell that he really wanted to make sure that we had a comfortable stay.
The building has 3 apartments in it, all managed by Mert, and he has a reception desk downstairs - it is set up a bit like a guesthouse. There isn't always someone at reception, but when we texted Mert that we ran out of toilet paper, it was delivered to our door within 15 minutes, so that was pretty fast! We barely heard any noise from the other apartments even though we knew there were guests in one of them - great soundproofing. The cleaner comes every few days if you want, and (the most amazing thing) there is a free laundry service. We just left our bag of dirty laundry and got it returned to us washed and folded!
As promised, Wi-Fi is excellent and hot water is plentiful. The bathroom is very nice - way more modern than it appears in the photos - and the shower is perfect and heats up right away. The smart TV is great, and the balcony provides great views on a clear day. Heating works well. There are even little details like electrical outlets built into the bedside tables. In general, the apartment is very modern and cozy. Really happy we stayed here!!

Ebru's loft is located in the wonderful neighborhood of Kalamis on the Asian side of Istanbul. It is close to so many amazing cafes and restaurants as well as being a quick walk to the seaside. In addition, it is a 5-minute drive to Moda, Kadikoy, or Bagdat street. Her home is extremely cozy and a great place to relax after exploring Istanbul. To make it even better, there is even a private rooftop patio with a beautiful garden where you can enjoy some morning cay or a glass of wine in the evening. Ebru is a fabulous host and treated me so well during my stay. I would highly recommend her home to anyone.
Clean apartment, huge terrace with a view, comfortable bed. Thank you 🙏🏼

Ebru’s place is finished to a very high standard - all furnishings are high quality and very comfortable. The wood burner and bath are also excellent extra touches!
Also the roof terrace is great!
The only thing lacking is reliable cooking facilities - but if you are just staying a short while and intend to eat out then this is not a problem.
I didn’t actually meet Ebru, although she lives just downstairs (I am guessing this suite used to be part of her house as there is a locked adjoining door) - but every part of the contact with her was superb. Thanks!
Perfectly located nearby the istanbul asian side nightlife, elegant apartment. Double check the address with the host beforehand

description:
Place located in Atasehir, a quiet, safe, residential neighborhood.
Central location on the Anatolian side.
Apartment on the second floor, bright and shining, decorated with vintage wood furniture.
Well-equipped and convenient for long stays.
2 bedrooms: one single bed, one double bed.
Spacious living room with peaceful energy.
Safe, free car parking.
Fast, stable 50mb internet.
Fans for hot weather.
Brand-new, earthquake-resistant building with an elevator.

reviews.text: Canol's apartment is really cute and cosy. The apartment has literally everything you need. The location is in a very location. There is a bus station 2 minutes walk and the Water Garden mall that is 15 minutes away. The location is quiet but there is a steep hill to the building that could be hard for old people but it is relatively short and was not a problem for us. Very clean and has enough space with two bedrooms. Canol is very nice and super helpful, and normally answers really fast. Very much recommended.

Can's place was a great value for our one-month stay. The street it's on is pretty steep, so maybe not best for anyone elderly or mobility impaired. It's a nice neighborhood in the middle of a lot of major malls like Watergaren, akasya, emaar, and Optimum outlets. A great spot if you like shopping. The bakery and coffee shop nearby are great places for coffee and food, and the Cagri grocery has everything you could want. It's also a short a drive from some great hospitals as well if you are coming for medical care. The apartment has everything you need to be comfortable. Our kids had fun using the parks which are a short walk away.
Can did a great job communicating and was a perfect host. We would gladly stay here again!

Canol is a great host, he helped me a lot during my stay, especially in my late check-in and check-out. The house was very clean, location is great near to many good malls like İstanbul Optimum Premium Outlet, Watergarden AVM, Emaar. Things to keep in mind if you plan to keep visiting the Taksim area every day, it will cost you a lot of time between the two sides Asia and Europe other than this all is great. thanks u Canol :)

Рядом с квартирой много автобусных остановок. До причала в Кадыкёе и пляжа Джаддебостан можно добраться на такси примерно рублей за 390-400 (по состоянию на сентябрь 2020 г.).
Также поблизости много кафе и продуктовых магазинов.
Квартира уютная, есть вся необходимая бытовая техника и мебель. Очень много кухонной утвари на разные случаи жизни. На балконе - сушилка для белья.
На кухне есть средства для стирки и мытья посуды. Также к нашему приезду была еда (крупы, оливковое и подсолнечное масло, сахар, соль, специи).
Вай-фай работает шустро и стабильно.
В доме есть лифт.
Жанол заранее подсказал мобильные приложения, которые могут пригодиться в Стамбуле (такси и доставка еды) и оперативно отвечал на все вопросы.
По средам и воскресеньям недалеко от квартиры работает рынок, где можно купить как вещи, так и продукты (примерный адрес: Örnek, Hasan Çelebi Sk. No:22).
There are many bus stops near the apartment. You can reach Kadıköy port and Caddebostan beach by taxi for 35-40 TRY (as of September 2020).
There is a plethora of food stores and cafes nearby.
The apartment is cozy. It has all necessary household appliances and furniture. The kitchen features a lot of various cooking utensils for different occasions. The clothes dryer can be found on the balcony.
The kitchen also has washing liquids and dish detergents. Besides, there was some food before our arrival (grain, olive and sunflower oils, sugar, salt and spice).
The wi-fi is fast and stable.
There is an elevator in the house.
Canol sent links to some potentially helpful mobile apps (taxi, food delivery) before our trip and quickly responded to all questions during our stay.
On Wednesdays and Sundays, you can find a market nearby where you can buy both food and various consumer goods (the approximate address is Örnek, Hasan Çelebi Sk. No:22).

it is a really nice apartment in a quiet residential neighborhood. The place was all new and the host left everything clean. However, the place is far from the major tourist attractions on the Asian side, but it is easily reachable by a combination of bus and metro, and a taxi ride from the Kadiköy pier is not expensive. So, if you don't mind staying off the beaten path, the place is a great find.

description:
Our 3 Bedroom large and design apartment is on the 3rd floor with high enterance of a historical building.
50 meters to Galata Tower.
3 Bdr. has 3 shower, 3 A/C and there are 2 WC in the apartment.
Cosy and boutique cafes and restaurants, independent design shops, galleries and wine cellars are all within walking distance. By walking 4-5 minutes to Karaköy you can take tram and go to Hagia Sofia, Topkapı Palace, Sultan Ahmet Mosque and Grand Bazaar Area...
Our wi-fi is limitless with 50 mbps.

reviews.text:
Erdem is absolutely the best host we have come across. He is always available, always responsive, and always helpful.
Our family of six were staying in Istanbul for three nights and Erdem made our stay a delight. He arrange round trip transfer for us and we had a very complicated arrival schedule spread across three different times. He provided clear instructions a checked on the drivers all along the way.
His tour suggestions were very good and we saw everything we wanted and more. As a finally to our perfect stay Erdem arrange dinner for us at Tershane Restaurant. Outstanding!
Erdems flat is exactly as advertised. It is comfortable, centrally located, and clean. I block from Galata Tower and an easy walk to all the main sights, metro, busses, and ferries.
The flat is up a few flights of stairs, so if you have heavy luggage or have accessibility limitations this might not fit. Also there is a mosque next door, so calls to prayer may bother some. We thought the hike up stairs were worth the view while sipping wine from the balcony. The mosque adds a cultural twist.
Erdem has done a wonderful job in establishing a high bar for Airbnb hosts. Stay here, you will not be disappointed.

Our flat was in a great location, just off the main shopping street and a 2 min walk to Galata Tower. The flat itself was as described and the hosts contacted us in advance to confirm what sleeping/bed configuration we preferred. We loved that each bedroom had its own shower, then in the hallway there were 2 WCs also. We were met by the host at check in and it was great she stuck around until late on Sunday evening as we were slightly delayed.
The only slight issue we had was very low water pressure when showering on most days; however I think this is a more general issue around the local area itself than the flat itself.
The flat is on the 3rd floor with no elevator so be prepared to do some stair climbing
Overall we were very happy with all aspects of our stay and would highly recommend Ganbaru Tours for your requirements. They are very friendly, responsive and are always willing to help out in any way they can. Being able to communicate via messaging app with them is invaluable.

This was a fabulous place. Very clean and stylish, very comfortable beds, and the location is hard to beat. The amenities are excellent - a big refrigerator and a washing machine were high on our list. The rooms have AC so very comfortable when it was warm. The street outside is pretty lively until late, but my sleep phones did the trick and my friends slept through it so not that bad. Erdem is an excellent host - very accommodating and helpful. He kept our bags because we came early and left late, and arranged our airport transport ( worth the small premium of getting your own because they come straight to you when you arrange it).

The location is excellent. Within a 30 second walk to a popular street that has great shopping and restaurants. This street leads to Istiklal street which doesn't close till 12 or 1 am. Lots of action everywhere. Alse nice walk to Taksim Square, New Mosque, Egyption Spice Bazaar and Grand Bazaar. All within 15 or 20 mins walk. Erdem and Turku were very responsive and helpful in arranging airport pickup/drop-off. The showers worked well (one in each bedroom) and we used the dishwasher as well as the washer/dryer. Excellent for longer stays. We especially enjoyed eating at the restaurant downstairs from the apartment and I became good friends with the managers. My wife's favourite drink was Churchill.... be sure to try it if you like lime and salt. The only thing I would say as a critique... be aware that the apartment has about 7 flights of stairs with no elevator (it's a historical building). We complained at first (taking the bags up initially) but after it became great exercise !!

The flat is in a wonderful location (historic building) in close proximity to a few cafes and major walking attractions. It was spacious, clean and a shower in each room was a plus. We had 5 adults and 2 children with plenty of room to not feel crowded. Erdem was very responsive and friendly. He arranged transfers to and from the airport for us.
Two items to note:
1. We had to walk up 70+ stairs to get to the apartment (great exercise) - no lift.
2. Bars/cafes downstairs are open till 2-3am and can be very noisy if you are trying to sleep.

description: The floors are parquet, the kitchen is new. Spacious environment.

reviews.text: Numan is an amazing person. He welcomed me first day, explained everything clearly and he gave me a key. The room is quite wide and it is include one big wardrop, sofa and bed. Bathroom, kitchen and living room were very clean. Numan’s communication was pretty good you can talk with him whatever you want and also you can take some advise about the transportation and area. Thank you very much Numan.

He is very kind and loving and the cat is very cute. He treated me very respectfully and even accompanied me to a faraway place to do something outside the house. This is very valuable. He would ask about me throughout the day and I could ask him if I had any questions. With a relative mastery of English, we could have a good interaction with each other. It also fully respected my privacy. the surroundings is very quiet and beautiful. the bed is comfort and cleanliness is good and wonderful. he washed my dirty clothes and dried them. in bathroom soap, shampoo and drier is available and in kitchen bowl, pan, glass, drinking water and everything you need is available.

he is a kind and polite person, always ready to help the guest. I stayed with him for 9 days, I had an operation at the BHT clinic, which is close to his house, 5 minutes away by car or half an hour on foot. and he helped me in many things during my stay, he came to pick me up almost at the airport upon my arrival, he called the taxi for me several times, he accompanied me out to pick it up, he ordered me some food to eat, a person lovely, definitely the best host I've met. His house is clean and the mattress is comfortable. he has an adorable cat, which he loves very much, more than himself. thank you for everything 😊🙏
very nice and comfortableplace to stay highly recommended

Çok samimi bir ev sahibi, çok keyifli bir konaklama deneyimi, Çinli bir turist olarak yemeklere alışamadığım için kendim yemek yapmak zorunda kaldım ve ev sahibine çok fazla zahmet verdim, bu yüzden özür dilerim! Tekrar Türkiye'ye gelirsem burada konaklamak isterim!

description:
Our place, a historical building, is centrally located in Beyoglu which is in the historical area of Istanbul.
The place is 11 min walking distance to Istiklal Street, bars, traditional restaurants, and night clubs. It is also very close to most important historical places such as Eminonu, Sultanahmet, Galata.
The metro and bus stations are 1 km and 450 m away, respectively.
It is located in the residential area. So it is important to be quite after 10 pm.

reviews.text:
Pros
Very clean apartment
Amazing view
The owner answers in a chat quite quickly
Good Wi-Fi
Insect net
Bus stop is 7 mins walking
Metro is 20 mins walking
Havaist stop is 20 mins walking
Cons
Quite noisy because the apartment on a hill and you here a lot of noise from cars
Quite dirty windows. This view deserves clean windows
Be careful that the apartment is in a hilly area. This is a challenge for a people with bad knees.
I like this very clean and cozy apartment with a picturesque view.

Hakan & Turkan’s place was exactly as pictured with a beautiful bird’s eye view over Istanbul. There was a full kitchen, including a microwave (very much appreciated as many other listings on AirBNB in Turkey do not have a microwave). The place was spacious with a comfortable couch and bed.
There were two small grocery stores on opposite sides of the street outside. While it’s easy to get lost in this area, we were able to find the best route that’s downhill to reach the place from Taksim Square or Istiklal if walking or using a cab. If you turn to the right outside the entrance, the street running past the grocery store is busy with frequent taxis, so easy to hail a cab there.
We loved staying here and stayed almost a month. This is a great location. Our hosts were available to respond quickly whenever we had a question, including bringing the microwave, an extra outlet for plugs, and letting us check out later. We really appreciate the great experience and will definitely stay here again when we visit Istanbul in the future.
Thank you!

It wasn't a very pleasant stay. Even though the price was really good and the area was ok, we had a few complaints:
1. Upon check-in, we were greeted by a man (who we suspecte to be the real owner of the place, not the ones listed on AirBnb) and who spoke only Turkish, which made it hard for us to communicate. When we made the actual check-in at 2 pm, a little girl took us to our apartament, so no trace of the people listed on the site.
2. We agreed from the beginning to leave the luggage after check out, however on that day the man in question wasn't available to help us, so we had to explain this to the cleaning lady, who didn't know English either, but which helped us get our luggage down from the second floor on some difficult stairs.
Also, it was very cold in the apartament during the night and it wasn't really clean when we checked in (plus there was a heavy smell of cigarettes all the time).

The apartment offers a good value for the small price. It's located in a hilly, local community with a 5 minute walk to a bus stop with many lines (I mention hilly here because that is a factor you should consider when carrying larger luggage or so). There are several small kiosk stores around and within a 15 minute walk, you can reach areas with restaurants and more stores. The apartment itself was clean and equipped with basic amenities, for 1 person it was spacious enough and also 2 persons could stay here easily. Communication was efficient and easy. Very good value for the price, can recommend.

A good place to stay for couples. It may not be ideal for families with young children or older guests due to the steep uphill walk. The apartment was clean and well-maintained, and the host was very responsive throughout our stay. The bathroom and shower area are quite small, and the staircases are narrow, but we were aware of this from previous reviews. Overall, it was a pleasant stay and we appreciated the hospitality.

description: The flat is just next to Galata Tower. Beyoğlu region and Galata was rebuilt after a big fire in 1870. We would define this date as the rebirth of Beyoğlu and say that many important historical buildings in Beyoğlu emerged after this date. The building was completed between 1875 and 1885 by French architects in a European style. You will feel 150 years of history at the Galata Tower Street, the foot of the tower.

reviews.text: Thank you Merve and Ahmet for the efficient communication. The studio is very clean and the host explained COVID 19 preventive measures. The apartment is organised in artistic sence. Specious and comfortable place located in the first floor is convenient to carry bags as there is no lift. Very closer to all the key attractions, shops and restaurants. Overall pleasant stay and I recommend this place who loves old fashion with comfortable stay. Only issue is Barth room is smaller than expected. Worth for the money and this stay made me feel satisfied as stayed in a historical site.

I had a wonderful time staying at this flat during my short trip to Istanbul. The hosts were very helpful and responsive and accommodating. The view from the terrace is unbeatable and I didn’t have any trouble sleeping at night although the street is quite busy until 11pm-midnight. There is so much to do within a walking distance from here, it is an absolute steal at this price!
I will say that the bathroom is quite small so if you’re a big person with muscles you may not be comfortable or really fit in. The water pressure was amazing though.
My one recommendation to the hosts would be to include a full body mirror in the flat :) As a 5’1 ft woman excited to explore the city and take pictures- I couldn’t see any of my outfits before leaving!
But overall I had a wonderful time and will probably book again.

Cute apartment in the amazing place. Bedroom is exactly like the picture. Kitchen and bathroom are dated, and water in the shower is sometimes cold. Windows are looking out to the other building. That building is beautiful, but it blocks the sunlight. Nevertheless, the apartment is very cozy and owners are always in touch. All the appliances work. The apartment is warm even when its 0 degrees outside. Heating can be regulated. The building is old and beautiful. Marble stairs, high sealings and doors. I loved it. Stores, pharmacy, cafes - everything is nearby.

I searched a lot on different websites until I found this apartment. I had no idea about areas of Istanbul and which is the best, but this apartment is literally beat location you can have in Istanbul in my humble opinion. Small streets with designer stores, hospital one minute away where we did PCR test for my German boyfriend before the flight. Small cafes, shops with food.
Apartment was exactly as on the photos. Be ready for super small toilet and shower, BUT water was always hot and strong. Basically there was everything you might need. And hosts were so kind even to bring 5 liters drinking water bottle. Highly recommend this apartment!

Location, Terrace view and communication before and after the check-in with Merve & Ahmet were excellent. The place was clean and equipped as described. Always felt in good hands because of their quick reply and helpfulness.

description: it has a very central location, 5 minutes to Taksim square and metro,bus stops, 2 minutes to Istiklal street. It is at a historical building. The street is also nice with cafes and boutique restaurants. There iswifi, oven, fridge, washing machine,etc

reviews.text: Dear Community, When you look at the photographs of this apartment it’s absolutely beautiful, comes across as spacious and friendly. When you arrive you see how tiny the space is like a little match box and you see that it is not like the pictures that are uploaded on Air Bnb. The negative reviews about this apartment is TRUE! Its extremely noisy. All Day from 5am in the morning the man who lives below plays he’s Television and speaks so loud it wakes you up. At first I tried to be positive and enjoy it as a Turkish sitcom experience but it got so intense I started having sleeping problems. I was always tired as he also made a noise till late at night and early mornings till mid day sometimes. I spoke to The Owners Cagri and Halil - they said they would fix it - obviously always promises but nothing happened. The woman who lives upstairs uses the washing machine and tumble dryer that is next to the room where you will stay in actually its a room not apartment well she uses the machines almost everyday for hours and hours basically all day. How she has so much washing - I have no clue but its extremely noisy. She is also very unfriendly often disturbing me and knocking loud on my door for no reason. The Room/Tiny Matchbox apartment is sooooo old and unstable the floors and walls shake when you walk even cups can fall and break if youre dancing. It can feel can like a mild earthquake I had a Terrible experience as an alone woman I always tried to politely talk to Cagri to solve the problems - she made me believe she cared but she never did anything about it so she obviously does not care about her customers comfort and safety because - The guy who lives downstairs came up to knock on the communial apartment door so loud screaming and shouting like really loosing it and going crazy such a bad dangerous and sad traumatic expericence for me as Single Women staying at this place. I was crying. He punched the door so hard shouting about upstairs noises. So if I walk he can probably hear me walking and I hear everything he does. The lady who lives upstairs I can even hear when she walks even when her cat walks but she would knock loud on my door and also start shouting. It was a true experience of harassment from these surrounding people, completely inappropriate behavior and these people are grown adults far much older than me to act like rude towards me and other guests. The saddest part is the owners did nothing. Also everything in the apartment is old all appliances most things didnt work and were broken when I checked in. Even the door and gate. Once Cagri sent the cleaning lady to clean the apartment and then I was blamed for breaking the door. When I left she blamed me for breaking her bed and stove. These things were so old I am extremely disgusted and disappointed that after I looked after Cagri place she would still have the audacity to try and charge me for things I did not do. The worst thing is she is not here in the country so it seems they like to blame customers for breaking there broken old things. The price is not worth. The safety is bad. The building smells like cat crap and cat food and the entrance of the building always has cat food layinng around so as you enter you have to walk through cat mess. The balcony you cannot really use there is also an old man that lives opposite and can see you so dont try and walk naked or open your blinds as ther is no privacy. The noise is terrible and I promise you your neighbours- will make this Aestheticly looking (apartment on these pics) the worst most uncomfortable experience and ruin your holiday. The kitchen is so tiny you cant cook. There is no space to put your clothing and the cupboards are filled with Cagri personal stuff and the apartment is extremely tiny you will no place to put your stuff the place is used to store other stuff. When I left I cleaned the apartment infact I always kept it clean in my stay I even cleaned the fridge. What a Complete Rip Off and Not a good place - dont waste your time and money with this one. Its Really terrible maybe you can even fall through the floor. Also when I arrived Cagri promised that there would be someone to help me carry my bags and i would have to pay like 50 liras I spent a weekend planning with her ahead but when I arrived there was no one. Even the man that was supposed to give me the key was not there. The only great about this place is the pictures.

Hi. I stayed in this apartment for a week at the end of August. Everything that is written about location and how fantastic Cagri is as a host is 100% true. I only want to write about a part that takes away the comfort - there is no air conditioning. At night you can not open the window due to noisy street and the fan does not help much - the stairs to the apartment (4th floor) are a small spiral staircase. Very difficult to carry up and down the luggage. -water in the shower became constantly hot and cold during the shower. Despite Cagri and Halil trying to fix it, it was not resolved. I understand that it is not the host's fault but it still takes away the comfort. I would still recommend the apartment if you are a young solo traveler who needs a budget partment in the center with its own bathroom.

Cagri is a very quick response host. He even text us to see if we’re fine when earthquake happened. The flat is very clean with full equipped. Shower, laundry, kitchen, balcony.
