And it’s location is amazing! 30seconds to the Main Street ,yet hidden in a nice small ally. We love the area full of restaurants, cafes and galleries. The only thing we felt less comfortable was some part of the floor in the room sinks a bit when step on. Since it’s a wooden+concrete structure, I think it’s normal for old buildings.
Would recommend it to couples or solo travelers whose seeking for some private space.

The flat is not suitable for 2 people. Health and safety hazards, extremely steep staircases (without landing on each floor) exposed electrical wires in communal areas, dirty communal areas. The owner of the property doesn't live in the country so your complaints will not go anywhere. The washing machine was located next to our room and was shared with other people in the flat which was continuously in use and the noise drove us crazy. The flat is decorated with cheap and flimsy furniture which falls to pieces easily. However, the flat is centrally located and there are good transport links.

Our stay at Cagri's apartment was wonderful. The location could not have been better. We were able to walk everywhere from the apartment.
The apartment itself was clean and comfortable for two people. It had everything we needed. While it faced a busy street and was sometimes noisy, it didn't bother me as I enjoyed the lively atmosphere.
We arrived at night and the check-in was smooth. The keys were provided without any issues. Overall, Cagri's place made our trip very convenient and we loved exploring Istanbul from such a central location.

description: Located in the heart of Taksim Square, Apartment offers modern comfort just steps away from vibrant Istiklal Street. Explore nearby cafés, restaurants, shopping malls, and art galleries. Our newly designed rooms are equipped with top amenities for a relaxing stay. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel, and an elevator provides easy access to all rooms. Whether you're here for business or leisure, Deluxe Room ensures a memorable stay in one of Istanbul's most exciting districts.

reviews.text: The apartment is in the most tourist place in the city, as described. Very clean, wide, comfortable and well organized for a family - never ending hot water, own entrance, places to store things, kitchen supplies. The only thing I really missed, is a coffeemaker, but we survived. We loved the yard to take rest in the evening. Mehmet is very comprehensive and polite, really helpfull, Thanks a lot!. If we visit Istanbul in future, we will look for this place again, for sure. I recommend!

It’s a wonderful location. Hosts are great friendly people. Apartment is perfect looks such as what it shown in photos has only one air condition for a whole apt. It’s really hard to find parking space around the area.

Really great place. Pretty good location, 5 minute walk to Taksim Square (and all the transportation options there). The beds were comfortable, the place felt like a home, the kitchen was fully stocked, the couches/living room were comfortable to hang out in. The bathroom was nice. Only complaint was that the shower doors didn’t work properly which made the bathroom floor get really wet (but that will probably get fixed soon). We really recommend this place!

Baris and his brother are both very polite! They picked us up from the bus station, directed us how to get to the bus ;-) ( thanks for that ! ) and even carried our Bags!! They welcomed us with muffins and Orange Juice - it was very warm. The apartment is located in a calm side-street of Taksim - but very near to the metro station. It's very clean because they cleaned it everyday !

We had nice days in Taksim, Baris welcomed us very friendly with little guest gifts for each of us. He was always there when we were in need of anything. The apartment is good located, it's easy to reach the metro station and Taksim shopping street by walking. There are also restaurants very close.
We recommend you to let them clean the apartment daily because the dust accumulates very fast.

description:
Our apartment was completely renovated on April 1, 2025. It has a modern and elegant look, located in the very center of Istanbul. You will enjoy the convenience of walking to all the city's major tourist attractions and centers of interest.

The interiors were furnished with your comfort and luxury in mind. Enjoy relaxing with comfortable bedrooms and a spacious living area.

We want to create a magnificent Istanbul experience for you. Make unforgettable memories. We'll be happy to welcome you.

reviews.text: The residence is located at the bottom of a big hill walkable to Taxim square. There are front staff 24hrs. There is ac in the apartment bedrooms, but not the elevators and building hallways. It was very uncluttered but very minimal. Example, missing hand soap, tea towel for the kitchen, laundry detergent, dish soap. It is a rental property, not a home. Our host was always responsive. Very local and busy area. Always easy to call an uber or hail a taxi.

the host was responsive and very nice person.The receptionist were so kind and helpful. About the location, it has very sharp uphills, is not recommended for adult people or some people who have heart problem! There wasn't any fan in the toilet so the smell of the well was in the apartment. There wasn't Microwave in the kitchen which I think it's necessary in every kitchen.
The windows wasn't covered the noise of outside!
but in general the building itself was secure and people who worked there were so nice and friendly! we had a good time these time! I just mentioned some small problem to inform to the host to solve it, which I'm sure he will taking care of it because he cares about his guests!

greetings from Lebanon.. everything was pure amazing starting from Cihan n the staff who were so friendly and helpful...Room was clean and exact the same of the photos.. and there was a bus stop near the residence.. i highly recommend it and will be my home anytime i visit Istanbul.. Teşekkür ederim!

Cihan was a great host—very responsive and helpful with any questions I had. The house is in a great location, within walking distance to Taksim and lots of fun touristy areas. (Just be prepared for some hill climbing—this has nothing to do with the house itself, but anywhere near Taksim means lots of steep streets, so bring good shoes!)
There’s a supermarket right in front of the building, which made cooking and eating at home super easy. The kitchen was fully equipped, and the balcony has a gorgeous sunset view. The pool was fun too! If you’re a bodybuilder, the gym might not meet your expectations, but honestly, with all the walking and hills around, you’ll get plenty of exercise anyway.
I requested a cleaning service and Cihan arranged it very quickly—we really appreciated that. Overall, I was very happy with this place, and I’ll be staying here again soon for my friend’s wedding party.
Thank you, Cihan!

We stayed in Cihan’s apartment for more than a week and everything was great. The place looks very similar to the pictures and is comfortable for both short and long stays. Cihan was extremely responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Highly recommended!
The only thing to note is the uphill walk to Taksim — about 10–15 minutes depending on your pace, with roughly 4 minutes being steep and the rest flat. The neighborhood itself is very lively, with plenty of cafés, restaurants, and grocery stores nearby

description: Genius Hotel Istanbul is literally around the corner from the most popular attractions in Sultanahmet. Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, The Grand Bazaar and Spice Bazaar are just a few minutes walk. You can catch the tram throughout the city, which is just past the Hagia Sophia. Also all the sights in Istanbul are easily reached by walking, if you want, and you get to take in the pure beauty of the city when you reach everything by foot.

reviews.text:
Staff at Genius Hotel was very friendly and helpful during our stay. They took great care of us & are always available when we need help. Best of all, there is a car park in front of the Genius Hotel and staff helped us park in front of their office. They also offered us umballa when it started to rain. The overall best service at the Genius Hotel is just around the corner from the Topcopy Museum, an ideal location for tourists.
Recommended.
Great place to stay in Istanbul. Excellent and quick communication from hotel. Location is perfect, most tourist attractions are within short walking distance. Would definitely stay here again.
For a short stay. The Room was quite good. It is Located direktly in the old City Center and Check in and Check out was possible at and time.

Superbe accueil avec une arrivée possible avant l'heure indiquée. Hotel très bien situé à quelques pas de la grande mosquée Sainte Sophie.
Seul petit bémol: l'hôtel ne propose pas le nettoyage des chambres ce qui est assez embêtant pour les poubelles et le papier toilette qu'il faut redemander tous les jours.
Tack så mycket för trevligt besök. Vi tyckte om hotellet och personalen och rummet som vi hyrde fungerade utmärkt. Vi kan rekommendera det till andra som vill upptäcka Istanbul.

description:
Just few steps away from Findikli Tram Station which goes to OLD CITY, 600 meters to Kabatas port and 800 meters from TAKSIM square.
Perfectly comfortable and classy as all eRa Houses.
-Elevator
-High Speed Internet VDSL
-Smart Tv with Wifi
-A/C
-Dishwasher
-Fridge
-Heaters
-Microwave
-Full equipment kitchen
-Washing machine
-Dryer (L.R.)
-Work Table/Chair(opt)

This building just for airbnb and it has 6 apartments.

reviews.text:
The house in itself is lovely, great location , clean and has everything that you need to have a comfortable and pleasant stay for a good price. There is some noise due to the busy road nearby but nothing over the top.
The hosts are very helpful and polite, always messaging to ensure you are happy.
We did have a few minor issues in the house:
Hot Water system is small and runs out of hot water very quickly.
The shower head is cracked at the top and throws water over the shower capsule and onto the bathroom floor.
Exposed electrical socket in the bathroom
Portable drying rack for clothes is broken.
These were no biggie, but something we did notice and changed the stay from great to good. All in all we’d be happy to stay here again

(+)
*Ora is very responsive and communicative as a host
*The location is very close to Galata Port in a wonderful area(no hills!)
*The apartment if not better is exactly the same as the photos and description and clean
(-)
*There are huge buildings in front of the windows which block all the light, indoor can be gloomy
*Hot water runs with a thermostat system hence, won’t last enough to take a shower. One must be very quick

This was a really perfect choice for our trip, the place was exactly what we needed in regards of space, location, and budget. The apartment was very clean, well-heated, well-maintained, and the building was very safe and quiet, no one can access without a code which made us feel comfortable. The location is perfect, very strategic to several transportation stations, and different coffee places with 2-5 minutes walk, places at the sea and others by the street. We stayed there for 3 days but we highly recommend it for extended visits. The host is easy to reach, sent us very clear instructions for self check-in and had the place ready with whatever needed.

Loved this place, excellent location for public transport links, including the public ferry which is right across the road.
The apartment had everything you could possibly need, even a washing machine which was really useful if you’re on a multi trip holiday like I was. I arrived with a case of dirty laundry and left with a clean case of clothes for my next stop!
The apartment was clean, cosy and the space was so well utilised. Communication with the host was excellent, I had no issues whatsoever with anything and will definitely return when I come back to Istanbul.
I wish I knew about this place previously because if you get on/off a cruise at Istanbul this is an excellent place to stay before or after as it’s 5/10 minute walk to the Galataport cruise terminal and is flat so easy to walk with luggage. Plus so much better value than the Hotels!
Thank you so much 👍🏻

We truly loved our stay at this apartment in Istanbul. The location is absolutely amazing and made getting around the city incredibly easy. The Asian side is easily accessible by ferry, and the T1 tram line made exploring the European side super convenient. The apartment itself was spotless, very well maintained, and always smelled fresh, which made it feel extra comfortable and welcoming. The hosts were outstanding - quick to respond, extremely helpful, and even available when we needed assistance in the middle of the night. We genuinely appreciated the care and attention throughout our stay. We will definitely use this apartment as our base when we return to Istanbul and would highly recommend it to others.

description:
The apartment is located on the Second floor. The building does not have a lift.
It is one of the old Greek Wooden architectural houses. The apartment is on the 2nd floor. There is not an elevator at the building.
Because it is a historical building need to be careful with sound after 21.00

I only allow smoking on the balcony.
I only allow smoking on the balcony

This is an oldest wooden apartment at the street in heart of TAKSIM .

reviews.text:
It's an excellent price/quality balance regarding the location and the interior design concept of the place. People from Emre's staff I communicated with at the neigbouring Ottopera hotel were very kind and helpful. I received a professional and friendly attitude and what's most important they spoke English fluently so we could communicate (I was surprised that communication in any other language than Turkish was a major issue around Istanbul and it was a problem even at four or five star hotels).
Location is realy 5 mins. away from Taksim square but the place is actually pretty calm and quiet. Apartment is stylish and had everything I needed. Wi-Fi was also good and you have access to Android TV apps. Place is good if you travel alone or for a couple.
Only thing I can recommend to future guests is to have in mind that the shower cabin space is limited and also you have to wait about a minute so the hot water "comes" to the shower. You might think at first there is not hot water but that's not the case. Just be patient!
I would visit again. Thanks to Emre and his staff for professionalism!

Exactly what you see on the pictures. I have just the best impression from the beginning. I booked the place and Emre contacted me to explain everything very clear.
The place is PERFECT. Beautiful, with all you need for a good stay. Shower and WC working well, same with the air conditioner (very important in summer days)
Towels and sheets smell like new, fresh and clean. Bed comfortable and kitchen equipment perfect for a short stay. Tv with Netflix, YouTube, etc.
The location is just 5 minutes away from the center of Taksim. Street easy to walk with bags and full of small places to eat or buy what you need.
Book it! you will not regret it !

Although our stay was not the most pleasant one, none of that was directly related to our host or his apartment. The apartment is exactly the same as described, nicely decorated and equiped well enough for a short or medium-long stay. It tends to be quiet and isolated from the street noise, but if you are a light sleeper consider it twice: the floor above is extremely squeeky and you will hear any noise from the stairwell as well (e.g. drunk/horny neighbor)
The guy who assisted with check-in was very kind and helpful. Perfect macro-location, 5-minute walk from Taksim square, Istiklal street, airport bus suhttle, etc. However, we did not like micro-location since the street and neighborhood are still going through fast-moving gentrification process: you will find many hotels and airbnbs there, abut also a lot of dilapidated and unoccupied buildings nearby. We didn't have any inconvenience, but I wouldn't recommend this location to the female traveling alone or going home at 3AM.

Emre’s studio is the perfect rustic sanctuary for anyone who wants to enjoy some quiet amongst the hustle and bustle of the busy Taksim area.
From the brick walls to the grand ceiling, to a clean and comfortable bathroom the studio offers the necessary comforts and bonus luxuries.
I would recommend staying at Emre’s place. The communication is fantastic too and there is always support available from the staff of the Ottopera hotel that he owns which is a few doors down from the studio.
Beyoglu is a busy area I would bare that in mind however the street which the studio is located is generally quiet, with people often sitting outside the barbers and cafes.

Well decorated and nice apartment. All clean and comfortable! You have everything you need inside. Pleasant communication and feedback. Located near Taksim square, close to everything. Still the view is a bit depressing to the ruined house against the apartment))
Check carefully the location before booking, you may not like it.

description: Stay in the heart of Maçka, one of Istanbul's most desirable neighborhoods, perfectly located between Nişantaşı and Beşiktaş. Hosted by Homie Suites, this bright one-bedroom apartment is ideal for both short and long stays. Enjoy seamless self check-in, high-speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning, and a comfortable space to unwind after exploring the city. Cafés, restaurants, parks, shopping, and public transportation are all within walking distance.

reviews.text:
Pros:
Great unit just like its photos
Clean linens, towels, bathroom
Close to Nisantasi neighborhood with plenty of boutiques (10 min walk)
10 min walk to great restaurants
3min walk to bus station
10 min walk to vapur station
Very responsive and caring host
Cons:
There was only one cons that I can say, unit is facing the main street so you can hear voices of people and cars.
We will be back again and recommend to others defiantly.

Clean, spacious and well furnished. Had lift so carrying suitcase upstairs was a breeze. Comfy bed and crisp clean linen and towels etc. My only gripe was that it is on a main road with regular flow of traffic and I am a light sleeper so I had to request a cancellation. The agency was extremely helpful, they offered a refund as well transfer to another of their apartments that would be quieter. I accepted the offer to move there. They paid for the taxi also, and issued my refund for unused nights.
I would say if you aren’t as sensitive to traffic noise as I am then you can’t find a better location to stay then this to make it your base and explore Istanbul. Some great restaurants and trendy cafes are a stone’s throw away.

Great stay!
Clean, cozy, and exactly as described. Perfect location, close to everything. The host was friendly and helpful, and check-in was super easy. Would definitely stay again

The flat was exactly same as the photos. Clean and cozy. Perfect location. You can reach lost of attractive places very easily. Host is really responsive and always asked if we need any help. Thanks very much for everything. I will definitely stay again.

Temizlik, konfor ve dekorasyon harikaydı. Fotoğraflardaki gibi hatta ondan bile güzel. Konumu çok iyi, ulaşım kolay. Evde ihtiyacım olan her şey düşünülmüştü. Homie çok ilgili ve misafirperverdi, iletişimimiz çok rahattı. Kesinlikle tekrar gelmek isterim, herkese tavsiye ederim! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

description: Hi, dear guest . If you are looking for the best option for holiday in Istanbul - our apartment to your service! The house is located in the historic center of the city (150 metres far from main Street Istiklal). All of attractions which you can find in Google and Youtube are in the nearest accessibility. When you'll come here i can share with you many tricks which only local people know and use .

reviews.text: Easy check in, comfortable bed, nice hot shower with strong water pressure. Shampoo, towels, and slippers provided. Overall, a clean, comfortable, convenient, and great value room.

This Airbnb was very typical. It wasn’t great and it wasn’t bad. The room was spacious enough and decent. The bathroom had some flushing issues and the water from the shower leaked out the bathroom each time, flooding the floor. The lighting is the room is pretty nonexistent. So if your doing makeup, the bathroom mirror is too high and the room mirror is too dull and dark to see anything. The bed just had a white sheet over it with no fitted sheet so that was disappointing and kind of gross that if we moved too much the sheet would pick up off the mattress. The location is close to everything. 15 minute walk to Karakoy or istiklal street. And tons of restaurants nearby. The actual hotel looked pretty run down. Like an old apartment building almost. The host that checked us in the was very nice and helped us schedule an in room pcr test and helped with recommendations. The room didn’t come with any water or coffee so if you do stay here make sure to hit one of the 100s of local grocery stores here.

Wir hatten insgesamt einen angenehmen Aufenthalt. Das Zimmer war sauber und ordentlich, und das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis war absolut in Ordnung. Die Lage ist gut – in einem lebendigen Viertel mit vielen Möglichkeiten in der Umgebung.
Das Haus ist allerdings etwas hellhörig, sodass man andere Gäste im Flur oder beim Kommen und Gehen hören kann. Wer empfindlich auf Geräusche reagiert, sollte das wissen. Ansonsten hat alles gepasst und wir haben uns wohlgefühlt.
We had an overall pleasant stay. The room was clean and tidy, and the value for money was absolutely fair. The location is good — in a lively neighborhood with plenty of things nearby.
The house is a bit noisy though, so you can hear other guests in the hallway or coming and going. If you are sensitive to noise, it’s something to keep in mind. Other than that, everything was fine and we felt comfortable during our stay.
Clean, was the same as the photos shows, the host was helpful with everything.

Oda fotoğrafta göründüğü gibi ayrıca temizdi. Hem güvenilir hem merkezi olması çok büyük avantaj. Bizim yüklü valizlerimiz olmasına rağmen ulaşım noktasında hiç yorulmadık yolu çok temiz yokuşu filan da yok. Fiyat performans noktasında rahatlıkla tercih edilir

description: It is within walking distance of Taksim Istiklal Street, the favorite touristic street of Istanbul, and Nişantaşı, one of the most ideal locations for shopping. One of the most central places of Istanbul in terms of transportation, in a lower street of Cumhuriyet Caddesi. Within walking distance to markets, bank branches, currency exchange offices, shops, shopping centers, historical churches, Maçka park, Gezi park.

reviews.text:
We enjoyed our stay so much! The apartment has been recently renovated and is beautiful just like the pictures! Kitchen is fully equipped and the sunset view is stunning 🤩 the location is perfect as it’s a 5 mns walk to Taksim metro station and around 12 mins walk to Nishantashi district. There are so many supermarkets , bakeries and other shops in the area.
The host was super nice and even helped us take the luggages up and down the stairs.
I would definitely book this apartment again.

Unfortunately we couldn't meet Selda, but her husband took care of the check-in and check-out. The apartment is as in the photos, the heating worked correctly, the neighborhood is quiet and safe, we felt at home. The sunsets look beautiful from the balcony. We hope to return one day.

Great stay. Clean, well appointed, good location and a friendly host. The entrance and stairs are a bit out putting but the appartment is great.
I would / will happily return.

We really liked to stay here. All things were perfect: location, style, view. We had really nice communication with owner, he met us and advised some restaurants also. You will get what you see on a photos here:) We can totally recommend this place to stay.

Lovely place with a great view not far from Taksim.
Plus: there is all u need in apartment, a lot of place, comfortable beds, panarama view in Istanbul
Minus: we were waiting for the check in, there is a mosque nearby and calls to prayer are heard very loudly

description:
Hello from İstanbul/Moda . İm Güfran (Guff) im a filmmaker.

İmportant: My flat is on the 5th floor and is accessed by 4 stairs. Dont worry I will help your luggages =)

A few steps to cafes, bars, ferry and subway station. Despite being at the center of Moda, it is located in a quite busy street across a historical bulding.
It's a modern and cosy apartment, enjoy it!..

reviews.text: The apt is located in a beautiful area of Kadikoy, about 10 min walk from downtown and equally to the ferry. My host met me at the apt upon my arrival and assisted me in taking my luggage to the apt located on the 5th floor. Unfortunately, there are no elevators, so get ready for a workout, but I enjoyed it regardless. The apt was clean, with adequate bedding and towels, to last the duration of my visit. It was as described in the Airbnb ad. The living and dining room had interesting contemporary art and a very nice collection of toy automobiles. The internet was very reliable, and I cannot recall any problem during my two-weeks stay. The kitchen had all the amenities one needs to prepare a healthy meal, with the host providing some spices for use. The bathroom was clean but was a bit small and one can easily be claustrophobic, especially in the shower. Regardless, the water pressure was satisfactory and the host provided shower gel and shampoo. The bedroom was large, with adequate space to store your suitcases, etc. I found the bed to be comfortable allowing for a good night's sleep. Throughout the apt, it was easy to achieve a comfortable temperature uniformly, regardless of the location inside. Outside the apt, one can easily walk to a coffee shop about 30m called Kanka cafe. Highly recommended. Overall, the host took all effort to ensure his guess would feel comfortable away from home. He replied to all my messages, if I had any concerns, within 3h. I would rate my experience an A-.

Staying at Guff’s place was amazing from the first to the last day😍 Perfect flat in perfect district. Metro and ferries are short walking distance (easy to get to the flat from Sabiha airport), a lot of cafes, restaurants around, peaceful Moda park 10-15 min walk. But the the flat itself is quite, so Moda noise won’t bother you.
Guff was very helpful. He helped us with the baggage, explained everything in the flat and welcomed us with some snacks & sweets.
The flat looks exactly like on photos: comfy, modern, made with love and care. From the windows in the living room you can even spot the sea. There is everything you need for a good stay in the flat. Wi-fi works good in the living room, had no problem with zoom calls. If we come to Moda next time, will definitely stay at Guff’s place again

I have nothing but great things to say about Guff and his place. He was very accommodating despite my very last minute booking, and was super responsive answering all my questions. The place is exactly as described, no surprises. Guff was there to greet me and was kind enough to provide drinking water and local snacks. 10/10 service.
The best part of this place is the location. If I ever return, I would reach out to Guff with no hesitation.

A truly homely feel in this appartement. we stayed for 5 weeks and had no complaints whatsover. Felt right at home and the location is just perfect.
Great communication by the owner and wpuld stay here again!
Good to know: it is 5 stairs up without an elevator and the shower is a little cramped if you're on the larger side.

This is a great location for those who want to enjoy the best of Istanbul's pub and restaurants and nightlife. The place is more than convenient. You can walk anywhere within minutes or just go around the block and pick a coffee shop. 5min walking distance to the west, the neighborhood called, "Moda" is a bit more quaint and peaceful. It has a boardwalk that goes forever. Perfect for morning walks or peaceful evenings to watch the panoramic waterfront of Istanbul.
The apartment is 10min from the ferries. You can take the ferry and see the old historic area Sultanahmet etc. or go towards the European coast of Bosphorus easily.
The place is comfortable and meets all the basic needs. A few convenient stores are minutes away for anything you might need. The bedroom sleeps well and gets a lot of daylight. It is a compact one bedroom that is perfect for a couple and plenty for a solo traveler. One thing you need to remember, there is no elevator and the flat is on the top/4th floor.

description: Terrace | 2 bedroom | 2 bathroom | 2 living room | 2 kitchen | Balcony | 4 AC units | Patio | 7/24 security system

reviews.text:
Positives:
Location is amazing, everything walking distance, size of the apartment with 2 bedrooms and extra office, big dining table, huge TV and comfy sofa, safe place, would recommend for bigger group who is looking for good value for weekend. Good communication with the host.
Negative:
Internet is very unstable so do not recommend for WFH, bathroom/kitchen looks much older than pictures, bed is not comfortable at all and both are small not even queen, in winter the apartment is very cold and one needs to extra heat with AC, when neighbors smoke you can feel it in the apartment through ventilation, I don’t recommend the apt for couples, not a comfortable stay, during our stay there was lot of noise from neighbors both upstairs and downstairs.

Great spacious apartment as described. Wifi (5ghz) is good for streaming and video calls. Very comfortable living and dining area. Clean kitchens and bathrooms. Iron and board. Good neighborhood with cute cafes around. Host was very responsive and helped arrange things like my early morning taksi for the airport. Very good place to spend some time for business or fun.

This place is just how it looks in the photos. It's on the ground floor across from the dog park which makes it a great people watching spot. The place is clean and tidy, and has a HUGE tv. Two decent size bedrooms which is hard to find in this neighborhood. Close to a lot of fantastic cafes and restaurants. Check in communication was easy - although its managed by someone who is not the owner. When I arrived the cleaner was still finishing up and she did not speak any English, but the person managing the listing called and explained what was happening. There isn't anything in the kitchen - eventually we realised water had been left for us but that was it. A good spot to use as a base for exploring this part of Istanbul. Thank you!

Simay is a real host! Worried with our staying, with our needs, and very helpful including on personal issues.
The apartment was spacious enough for a 3 people family, comfortable, nice tv, well equipped kitchen, in a great location, with a playground just crossing the street (great for young kids).
In another hand, the social area and kitchen are very dark, and the living room doesn’t have a single ceiling light. The awesome window in the living room, make us feel a bit uncomfortable, since the apartment is in ground floor, letting every person walking on the street see us in the living room… Kitchen was well equipped but missing things that were mentioned on the description. Beds are not king size… I had to sleep in another room because the bed was too narrow for a couple and a baby… Rooms were quiet and dark. Perfect to sleep, if was not the up floor neighbors that shouted to eachother at night since day one, sometimes 3, 4am…
The biggest downside was the bathroom… The bathtub was the main topic for us and our daughter to rent the apartment. First day the bathtub was leaking, and was fixed for the second day. Unfortunately, the water was standing hot for no more than 15 or 20 minutes, what was not enough to fill 50% of the bathtub. After 20 minutes, the water gets cold, taking a couple of hours to be able to get hot again. This made our daily family shower process endless…
Overall we had a good staying, but in our opinion the apartment is overpriced.

First of all, I'd like to thank Ms. Sara for her hospitality and kindness. She's very helpful with everything and has beautifully decorated the house, making you feel right at home. Everything has been carefully thought out from start to finish. There are two bathrooms, which makes your stay easier if you're traveling with several people, and another plus is the two kitchens, so you don't have to go upstairs or downstairs if you need something. The house is perfectly furnished with high-quality materials and comfortable furnishings. They've divided the house into four floors, creating a spacious living area. The ground floor has a living room with a cozy terrace, -1 floor has a bedroom, shower, and kitchen, +1 floor has a bedroom and shower, and +2 floor has a living room with a spacious kitchen and a cozy balcony with a table and two chairs, perfect for relaxing outdoors. The central location means that important places in Istanbul are within walking distance. The area is also quiet!

description:
Erasmus students! Please ask your special monthly rates!
Welcome to your City Home in İstanbul! Enjoy the city all day and relax in this serene apt. This renovated historical one bedroom apartment located in historical, central but also residential part of Istanbul, 7 min walk to famous Istiklal street which gives easy access to best restaurants, bars, cafes, sights of this amazing city.

reviews.text:
We stayed at Aylin’s place for one month and were very satisfied. We were personally met at check-in and treated with warm hospitality, and also at check-out. The apartment itself is on a little side street, so it was very quiet, especially at night. It was also pleasantly cool, even though it was summer, I guess because the walls of the building are so thick. We never felt that we needed air conditioning. The living room has a huge TV with ten or more English-language news channels, and the wifi was good (but doesn't extend well into the bedroom, maybe due to the thick walls). The kitchen is well equipped, better than just about any other AirBnB we’ve stayed at. Lots of dishes, pots and pans, coffee maker, electric kettle, etc., etc. And the whole apartment was very clean.
After a month of exploring Istanbul, I'd have to say the location of the apartment is almost perfect. And if you are into walking, like us, you can ramble on foot just about everywhere. To travel further afield, Taksin Metro station and Sishane Metro station are both about 10-15 minutes walk away, and buses and taxis are no more than two or three minutes away, on the nearby main street. The ferry that goes along the Golden Horn, across to the Old City and across to the Asian side is also an easy walk.
There are LOTS of restaurants, cafes, bakeries, fruit and vegetable shops, etc., etc., nearby, so finding food is not a problem. For supermarkets, there is both a Sok and a Carrefour (two popular supermarket chains in Istanbul) less than five minutes’ walk away.
On a more esoteric note, if you are a jogger (like my wife), there is a nice park, Haciahmet Cinderesi Park, nearby that has a decent-sized jogging circuit, plus a lot of outdoor exercise equipment. Places to jog are few and far between in Istanbul!

The place is amazing, it has everything you need to feel at home.
All amenities are provided, you have everything you need for a short or long stay.
Location is great, about 10 min walking to Taksim Square, 6 minutes to Istiklal street. Peaceful day and night, bedroom gets really dark, bed is a bit squeaky but very comfortable.
The table is a bit low and chairs are regular size, so it is a bit uncomfortable to eat and specially to work, and I also missed having a kitchen knife to cut vegetables and meat, but apart from that, all great.
Host is very kind and super helpful.
It is a great deal if your looking for a bigger place in Istanbul, I'm definitely going back!!

Beautiful and comfortable, perfectly clean, and very well-equipped ground-floor apartment. Smooth check-in and check out. Situated in a quiet local district with 1-2 supermarkets nearby (Carrefour Mini, Sok) and within short walking distance to the tourist area. (Istiklal Street - main shopping street)
Overall the apartment exceeded my expectations!

I had a great stay in Ailin’s place for a whole month, the place is fully equipped with all you would need, the kitchen is awesome, and the apartment was very clean, full of towels and equipment.
The internet connection is fast (I worked remotely), but the WiFi or cell data doesn’t arrive in the bedroom at all, that may be a problem if you go to sleep and you're waiting for some important call.
The location is good, but I wouldn’t say perfect. Yes, it’s close to the center, shops, restaurants, etc, but it’s after a few dodgy streets that aren’t that safe at night, and taxis don’t arrive directly at the apartment location. I recommend it! you will have everything you need during your stay.

The place is very nice, totally worth the price. Pelin (Aylin's friend) is a fantastic host. I'm definitely sure she helps you in any situation! Nearby there are cafes, supermarkets, and bakeries. There is a heater, hairdryer, lots of towels, a kettle, Turkish coffee maker, stove, dishes and some spices for cooking. Really good WIFI. Ideal for 2 people who want to enjoy Istanbul.

description: Our apartment is 1 minute away from İstiklal Avenue, 5 minutes away from Taksim Square and the Taksim metro station, and a 5-minute walk from Cihangir. The road leading to our apartment is straight. There are all kinds of cafes, restaurants, bars, nightclubs, shopping centers, and entertainment venues in the vicinity. Our location is ideal for enjoying the historic and modern parts of Istanbul's Beyoğlu neighborhood. Since our street is one of the quietest in this area at night, you can rest without any problems.

reviews.text: To be honest the place is great, location wise it is accessible to most of the things. Convenient stores, restaurants, rooftop bars, and cafe are just around the corners. Descriptions matches the photo, the down part was it was not properly clean. Dishes are dirty, crack glass stoves, and cockroaches “due to construction” around the area. The place really requires a proper maintenance to preserve its beauty. We love the place, but we cannot stay to a place with lots and lots of cockroaches, as they can go inside your ears. I would really loved to comeback to this place, if those issues will be addressed promptly as they have a very cosy and homey vibe.

The apartment is located just next to istiklal street so the location is great. Its a perfect apartment for 2-3 people for a short-term stay. It was clean and tidy. The building has a lift which is a rare find in Istanbul. Highly suggest this apartment

Ferid's apartment is in a really good location, just a minute from Istikal street. There is a lot of caffes and shops around, and neighbourhood is really pleasant. Apartment is well equipped, and was perfect for two of us. Ferid helped us find a transport to airport and was responsive and helpful. Would totally recommend!

It was an incredible place. Very beautiful, fully renovated and convenient considering that we had a kitchen. Also the location was perfect for going sightseeing since everything was pretty close.
And also big thanks to the owner, he was always ready to help and was very respectful.
Temiz ve lokasyonu harikaydı. Yalnizca dairenin hemen karsisinda bulunan okulun zil sesi rahatsiz etti biraz.

description: Located at the seaside of Cihangir/Beyoglu (hip area in Istanbul full of cafes, bars and galleries) this 160 m2 deluxe flat is 2 minutes walk to seaside & tramway, 15 minutes walk to Taksim city centre & subway. Designed with japandi style furnitures, this bright apartment has magnificient bosphorus view on all its rooms and areas. It accommodates up to 6 people. From espresso machine to cold water dispenser, yoga equipments or free netflix... All your needs for a dreamy holiday are available.

reviews.text:
Our 6-week stay was exceptional. This huge apartment features massive windows with stellar views, 3 big bathrooms, and comfortable beds. It truly accommodates 6 guests as advertised. We love to cook, and the kitchen is highly functional and well-equipped.
The host is extraordinarily responsive, answering in minutes. When our water heater spontaneously failed, he responded with lightning speed and replaced the entire unit within a day. The home is extraordinarily well-stocked with soaps, detergents, and cleaning supplies. Daily water delivery and trash pickup were very effective, and the lighting is great for any mood.
The location near the T1 Tram and Kabatas Ferry is perfect. We also appreciated that it is pet-friendly; our two cats were welcomed (everyone in Istanbul loves cats!). This place was worth everything we paid and is perfectly set up for long-term guests. Highly recommended!

This is a great apartment with expansive views across the Bosphorus through a wall of windows! Great views during the day and especially at night when the city is lite up. The bedrooms were large and the beds were clean and comfortable as were the bathrooms. The kitchen is well equipped. The host was very responsive to requests for grocery stores, restaurants and services in the area. The apartment is away from the busy tourist areas and has a neighborhood vibe. As stated in the description and in other reviews there are uneven stairs to get to the apartment and a hill to walk up to get to an easy spot to catch an Uber. The host arranged a taxi from the airport to the apartment and back again which was extremely helpful. Overall it was a very peasant experience and we would stay there again.

This place is beautiful and is exactly as pictured. That said, it is impossible for the pictures to do justice to the incredible panoramic views of the Bosphourus. It was absolutely stunning, including views of the first bridge, the Asian side, and Dolmabahce Palace. The apartment was large, with a nice kitchen, large living and dining area, three well-sized bedrooms, and three full bathrooms. There was also plenty of storage and closet space. The apartment is also modern, extremely clean, had comfortable beds and nice linens, and is tastefully decorated. Taigoun was also a very helpful and responsive host. It was an easy tram ride into the old city to see the historic sites. The only downside of this place is that it is a little tricky to find, and there is a long set of steep stairs to get from the apartment to the tram. So I would not recommend this place for someone who is mobility impaired or has trouble with stairs.

We had a really lovely and comfortable stay at this apartment. It was clean and spacious and had so many thoughtful amenities, we were really impressed. It was truly 5* service. The location is great as you can get to most places fairly quickly, however, we wish we knew beforehand that it was on a hilly area and we were required to climb a lot of stairs in both directions! Travelling with two elder parents it was sometimes quite challenging and the taxi doesn’t drop you off outside the door. Nonetheless, if you’re fit enough to get to the top, it’s worth it as the views from the living room are quite astonishing. Tygun was a wonderful host and great at communicating. He also gave us lots of local places to visit and booked us a transfer to the airport. All things considered, everything was a smooth process and we would recommend staying here.

My friends and I absolutely LOVED this stay! The view from the apartment was LOVELY!! Check in was so easy and Taigoun was very proactive in making sure the place was easy to find—he sent pictures with clear directions prior to check in. The accommodations were modern and comfortable. The kitchen and entire apartment was well equipped. I appreciated that there was already full size shampoo and body wash in the showers, along with slippers for every guest. At check in we had a bottle of wine and chocolate waiting for us—this was a nice surprise. I highly recommend this stay!! The only note about this location is make sure you are comfortable going up and down steps…this is true for any place you choose to stay at, in this location, specifically. There are a lot of steps and steep inclines in this neighborhood. We would stay here again!

description: Newly renovated and specially designed penthouse in the heart of Taksim /Beyoğlu. Just 30 meters to İstiklal Street. Well equippied 27m2 studio in the 5th floor (no elevator). It includes kitchen with refrigerator, cooker, LCD TV, bathroom and all necessary utilities to cook. There are 2 double beds and 1 sofas that can be convertible to double bed. So in total 6 people can stay at maximum (see the floor plan in pictures)

reviews.text: This is very cute stuido in the center of the city. Very good value for money. Highly recommended. It is new , clean, stylish and very comfortable. It is one big room with 2 double beds and 1 sofa. We were 6 people and we didnt bother staying in the same room. There is a thick curtain seperating the room into two. So you can create some privacy. Kitchen is okay. There is enough utilities to cook. There is also big table enough for 6 people. Internet and heating is very good. Location is the best! The apartment is very close to İstiklal Street where you can find everything you want. Shops, cafes and restaurants are all around. Eating is not expensive actually food is very good at accesible price so we didnt bother to cook at home. to be 5th floor was challenging but we didnt bother because we are in the center of the city and the apartment is so good. We really enjoyed our stay here a lot. Finally thank you Erol! You are great host. You are always reachable and fast in responding. This is great airbnb experience for us.

One of the best I have ever been so far. Very good value for money when you are 6 people! I m happy that I found this apartment. Yes it is 1 room studio but more than enough to host 6 of us. Very nicely renovated. Very clean and comfortable. Good wifi. Less furniture but high quality. Location is best of all. You are very close to what you want to see. İstiklal street is just your next door. Love this apartment. We spent very good time without any issue. Host is great. Thanks for everything. We recommend it!

Don't miss this apartment. It is highly recommended. Really very good value for money. Central location, very new (just renovated) , clean and comfortable. Neighbourhod is full of good restaurants cafes and bars. Big fun around. Vert nice host. He is helpful and responsive. As a family of 6 people we really had a good time in this area. We will come back.

We spent a great time in Istanbul and apartment was great - great location, easy to find, very clean, shops, bars, metro stations are very close. It was equipped with everything that was described by the host. There is enough space for the family with three kids. Erol is reliable person that answer any questions you may have very quickly and gives clear instructions. Erol thank you once again for everything.

Very good location, right next to Istiklal Street with many restaurants and bars around. Mind that it’s a 5th floor with no elevator, but we had no problems going up and down. Spacious beds, big couch. Overall had everything we needed for a good price. Erol was very nice, responsive and always quick to help.

description:
This special place is close to everything and makes it easy to plan your trip.
Comfortable and stylish apartment 20 steps from Galata Tower.
All the Beds and Linens are new, Two Air Conditioning (Living room and Bedroom), the Washing machine, the Dryer, Hot water anytime and Two Bathroom ( 1 wc-shower and 1 only shower). There is a cute pub on the ground floor of the apartment.
In the very heart of the city, it is great to meet all your needs and to be within walking distance of ALL Great places

reviews.text:
The place was nice and in a great location. It was spacious, and the host was very friendly and helpful — we needed extra towels and he arranged them the same day. Everything in the apartment worked, but most items were a bit worn and felt older.
There’s a pub directly below the apartment, so there’s noticeable noise at night. We knew this beforehand, but anyone sleeping in the front room will hear the music until late. Just be aware before booking. On the upside, the neighborhood itself felt safe.
The apartment was clean, and it matched the photos and description. Check-in was easy, and we were allowed to check out later at no extra cost. The Wi-Fi worked but wasn’t great. Beds were very comfortable.
The location near Galata Tower is excellent, especially since the area is usually expensive. Great neighborhood for tourists — we walked to most major sights almost every day. Overall, good value for money.

If you want to get a real feel for this extraordinarily vibrant part of Istanbul-only literally seconds from Galata Tower--Ilker's apartment is the place to stay.
In this flat you can accommodate a family of 6 or maybe 7 at the centre of all the action, The flat is lovely and located in the historical area so you have every thing in your finger tips.
One concern only for light sleepers, the noise from the square and Galata Tower side and the bar next door which closes at 3am might not be so good for sleeping early but who wants to sleep early on holiday, right? But still better to bring ear plugs or sleeping pills. Although We didn't need those as We were going to sleep late.
""The good things"" (we stayed one week) :
1. Centre of action, good location.
2. 3 Bedrooms with 3 double beds and two bathroom (one has toilet)
3. Clean towels linen
4. Washing machine (We couldn't sort it out)
5. TV and android box
6. Ilker is nice and friendly person which was available and happy to help and was flexible about check in and check out (We left luggages in apartment after We checked out and collected few hours after, as our flight back was late evening)
7- It is a very old historical building, so outside and stairs are very very old, but good thing is that it has got a very small (One person only) Lift which helps a lot for languages or if you have an elderly with you.
""Things to consider"" :
1. A bit noisy all day&night and shops opens early morning, however We liked it and did not bother us but it good for some to know.
2-Dishwasher is not available .
3. Hot water is available most time, but can be tricky every now and then when two person taking shower on different bathrooms at the same time, but Ilker is very friendly and came over and sort that out for us.
4. Windows need repairing as it is very tough to open/close them specially in sitting area or maybe get a double glaze to prevent noise come in.
5. Building's front door is super heavy and is built by strong Iron and not easy to open so it might be a concern for elderly or someone with arthritis or hand issue or even a bit weaker person.
-In conclusion decor wise the flat is good and feels like home and Ilker is very friendly and happy to help and got back to us very quickly whenever We needed help. If a family of 6 were to stay here price-wise it really is quite reasonable when priced per person and is spacious enough to accommodate comfortably.
If I would rate the flat out of 5, I probably would go for 4.5 however because of Ilker and him being helpful, flexible and friendly I would definitely leave a 5 Star review for him.
Thank you and hope to see you again Ilker :)

10/10 stay. Family with two teenager. What you see in the listing profile is what you get. First floor of local building with a small lift/elevator to help with luggage.
Large three bedrooms, clean sheets and towels, big lounge and functional kitchen and bathrooms with washer and dryer for a comfortable stay.
You are literally 30m from Galata tower and close to everything else in Istanbul. Absolutely no complaints about the very central location. There is a wonderful local breakfast place just across the road and a Migros mini mart near by for basic supplies. The streets are super quiet in the morning so it means you can get up the tower before the queues and the crowds arrive.
There is a small pub downstairs but they seem to be respectful and it doesn’t get too noisy.
IIker the host was super communicative and helpful. Check in and check out were seamless.
If you are looking for a comfortable place to stay in the historic heart of Istanbul then you won’t go wrong staying here.

Ilker’s place was just as described. It’s full of character and the location could not be better. Noise was not an issue at all. The house was very clean. Ilker supported an early check in and recommended some great places nearby. The air conditioning was AMAZING and the house stayed cool 24/7 - a great reprieve from the heat at this time of year! Thanks Ilker, we hope to be back!

Great location from which to explore Istanbul. Everything is within easy walking distance and we really liked the Galata Tower district. The apartment is clean and tastefully decorated, exactly as described and on the photos. Ilker was a great host, very friendly and responsive, gave excellent instructions and recommendations on places to go. It is in a bustling area, right next to Galata Tower, so there is noise from the street below, which didn't bother us too much as we expected it and we were out enjoying the city and all it has to offer. The bedrooms in the back of the apartment are much quieter, and the noise does cease eventually late at night. The beds are very comfortable and we slept very well. Definitely recommend if you want somewhere in a great area, close to everything and don't mind some noise. Wouldn't recommend if you want somewhere quiet.

description:
Room size is 20 m²
Yakut Apart Hotel offers rooms in Istanbul, 500 m from Blue Mosque and 500 m from Column of Constantine. Located around 800 m from Grand Bazaar, the hotel is also 901 m away from Hagia Sophia. The property features a 24-hour front desk. At the hotel, all rooms are equipped with a wardrobe and a flat-screen TV. The private bathroom is fitted with a bath. We are looking make your stay enjoyable with us and We speak your language

if you are looking for budget place its okey because these pictures took when it was brand new. not current pictures.
bathroom was little bit rusty and was not cleaned stains on toilet seats and water was not drining during shower.

the guy downstairs at yakut restaurant Ibrahim was very friendly let us check in before 12 as we were in the city.

this would be last option if i come back here again. i would spend little bit more and go to 4 star hotel.

The host Mahsun and his team are super kind, responsive and helpful! Their hospitality really made our trip super pleasant for us! We enjoyed the stay, the food in their restaurant downstairs was amazing, the room was comfortable and the location is great! Absolutely worth every penny!
On the first day we faced a couple of issues, but they were instantly solved thanks to the host's quck response. They really did everything to help us!
I would love to come back here when I return to Istanbul next time!

The host was friendly and communicative although he couldn't give us any good advices on which places to visit in the city or good restaurants to eat (as he is himself an owner of one)
Anyway as for the room, it was more dusty than it should, the bathroom sink, toilet and shower were not very clean and we had to take a small box of chlorine and clean them ourselves in order to use them. The location was OK but not perfect because you had to walk uphill 400-500 to reach the main roads which lead to the sightseeing and the markets (with no mean of transportation up until that point)
Overall, it was our first time in the city and we didn't really know where it would be better to stay, but the next time i will spend 10-20€ more per night to stay somewhere more in the center of the eminonu area and in a more cleaner apartment.
I would give 2.5/5

Clean place in very historical neighborhood.. a little far from transportation by walk.
Wi-Fi was great.
Host responds quickly and very helpful.

Overall good stay, you're an easy walk from all the main tourist attractions (Ayasofia, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, etc). There is AC in the rooms and for the rest of the room, you get what you pay for which is a good value. Ask for entrance to airbnb ahead of time, the address listed on the posting was about 200 meters from the actual entrance.

description: The best place you can stay in the very heart of the historical peninsula . located on the calmest street of the neighbourhood only 50 steps away from the TOPKAPI PALACE , HAGİA SOPHİA and SULTANAHMET MOSQUE

reviews.text:
This is the best Airbnb rental I have ever experienced on a wide variety of levels. First, the location is the “bullseye” location for historical Istanbul and simply can’t be beat. Second, the units have been designed, developed and furnished at a high level – it feels both very warm but also very professional and solid. Third, the host, Volkan, is superb. It has generally been my policy to only stay with Superhosts and Volkan is the best host I have ever experienced in my years of staying at Airbnbs domestically in the U.S. and abroad. Volkan is intelligent, honest, responsive and helpful. For someone visiting Istanbul without any connection in Istanbul, having such a host provided a benefit that, while difficult to measure on a monetary basis, is of tremendous value.
A few things to note. First, the stairs do wind a bit and are not easy for those with mobility impairments. My 82 year old mother was able to climb them but it required effort. Second, although Volkan provides all of the appropriate equipment (overhead fan heating, electric space heaters, rugs) to keep the apartments warm the units are stone buildings so they (at least in April) are cool and people should consider bringing a pair of warm socks for their feet if they don’t want (like me) to keep the heat on all the time. Third, Sultanahmet is very valuable real estate so while the units use space very effectively, bathroom space, etc. is compact. Fourth, traffic everywhere in Sultanahmet is quite difficult, so walking around to nearby sites is preferable.
Please note that the picture shown on Google Maps for Seyit Hasan Sk. No:14 (the address) is not correct. This can be determined on its face since the number in the picture is not 14, but 10. DO NOT BE MISLED BY THAT PHOTO AS IT IS NOT EVEN THE CORRECT LOCATION – this issue may be due to the fact that Google Maps seems to depict the location of the units as if they face Utangaç Sk., when it reality they face on to Seyit Hasan. The units have a beautiful exterior. The actual location can be seen correctly be searching on Google Maps for Seyit Hasan Sk. No:16 (which is next door) and then looking at the adjacent property. However, you will note if you look carefully at the Google Maps info that the Streetview info is from November 2017 – the exterior of both Blue Suites by V (the Airbnb location) has been extensively remodeled since that time so Streetview is also inaccurate. So, to see the correct exterior you should search in Google Maps for “Blue Suites by V Istanbul” (see https://www.google.com/maps?q=Cankurtaran,+Blue+Suites+by+V,+Seyit+Hasan+Sk.+No:14/1,+34122+Fatih/%C4%B0stanbul,+Turkey&ftid=0x14cab9bb8ff946a9:0xd5f89a6fefb9d16e&hl=en-US&gl=us&entry=gps&lucs=a1&shorturl=1) which shows the current exterior.
The appreciation of this Airbnb comes from its value. It may be more expensive than some other places but the when you consider the location, the quality of units in terms of construction, design and furnishings, and the benefit of such a wonderful and responsive host, the value of this Airbnb is outstanding.

The 2 flats (upstairs and downstairs both included) are in a beautiful, historic, convenient and extremely safe area. Volkan cheerfully met us upon arrival and made us feel right at home. He answered all of our questions and let us know he would be available if we needed anything else during our stay (and he really was — we texted him for restaurant recommendations and for airport-transport coordination and he was always immediately available and responsive). The flats were very clean, had everything we needed for comfort (exactly as listed in the Airbnb posting), and had the bonus of friendly and helpful shop owners all around the neighborhood. We ranged in age from 50s to 80s and we all loved our stay there. The one thing to keep in mind is that there is a flight of steps to get to even the downstairs flat — not a problem for us, but worth mentioning.
I would happily stay at this location again and would love if all Airbnb hosts were as great as Volkan.

Location well located near mosques and shops.
We rented the two apartments on two floors. Pay attention to the perspective photos: the volumes are narrow (30 to 35m2 per apartment). The upstairs toilets are tiny.
We took the transfer option with the host. The taxi was not there, with my family we turned at 6 for more than 30 minutes before hitting a taxi.
The host did not deign to apologize, however he insistently demanded the full transfer price. He even insinuated that we were liars. We do not recommend it!

We were a family of 6 who stayed at Volkens place for 5 nights. We loved our stay at the airbnb. Volken was very responsive, helpful, and a great resource to us. The airbnb was very clean and in the perfect location within walking distance to the Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, and other landmarks. We had a difficult situation with luggage and Volken went above and beyond to assist us. He even assisted us in setting up transportation to and from the airport. Our stay was comfortable and enjoyable with clean rooms, AC, wifi and all the necessities which made our visit to Istanbul even more memorable.
Volkan was also respectful and gave great recommendations. Ask him about local foods and activities and you won’t be disappointed. Would highly recommend!!

The location of Volkan’s place is simply incredible. You won’t believe how close you are to everything you need to be, especially if it’s your first time in Istanbul. The main plaza is literally around the corner, with the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Topkapi Palace just a few steps away. Endless places to eat and shop are also at your footsteps. Plus, Volkan’s place itself is clean, and bigger and more comfortable than photos show. And you’ll find in Volkan a great host; responsive and willing to help with all your needs. Consider yourself very fortunate if you find this place available on your preferred dates. It’s just the best!

description: This unique place has its own style. A unique place with a sea view and a view of the Sultanahmet Mosque, with a terrace balcony on both sides and a mini kitchen behind the Sultanahmet Mosque...

reviews.text:
They hosts were very responsive and very nice.
The teakettle did not work. This was mentioned in previous reviews. My husband took the teakettle to the office, and they replaced it.
The space was just like the pictures. There is no curtain so everyone can see inside so be aware of that. They really need a curtain.
The towels looked like rags you would wash your car with, but they were clean and the shower was very nice with ample hot water.
The bed was super comfy.
There is a train that is quite loud, but it seems to stop running around 10 pm. There are seagulls that are quite noisy.
But this place was great for three nights. We were seldom in the room.

The host was extremely responsive. The location is absolutely breathtaking with the two balconies. Some things to keep in mind is that it’s by a train station so you will hear and feel the trains passing from time to time and you are close to the mosques so the loud prayers will wake you up at 4am so wear ear plugs to sleep if you don’t want to be disturbed.
The air conditioner stopped working which was an issue since it was the dead of summer but the host was extremely responsive and had it fixed. Overall it was an amazing time and worth the price.
Very nice place exactly same as the photos in the ad , 5min walk to restaurants bars market

The views were fantastic and the place was in a convenient location. The place could use a mop as the floor was very dusty. The A/C only worked when it wanted to and had visible mould inside. There are no blinds on the windows so the room gets extremely bright very early. This room is actually apart of a hotel, so staff are entering the room throughout the day to change towels and remove rubbish without notice

Nice apartment with views to sea and to Blue Mosque. Perfect location and many sightseeing spots are just a short walk away. Communication was smooth and host responded to messages very quickly. Would recommend!

description:
Jun-Do Taksim is located in the heart of Istanbul. Just few steps away to Taksim Square and Istiklal Avenue.
The building has 7 airbnb apartments with large elevator. Each apartment has new furniture with well equipped. We try to think everything for our guest comfort.
High class, comfy,, luxury,,,whatever you need by eRa Quality.

reviews.text:
Strongly recommended 👍
Easy self check in. Elevator available in the building.
Very nice apartment with modern design and furniture.
It has living room with kitchen and 2 bedrooms with 1 bathroom.
Living room has smart TV with good WiFi connection.
Kitchen has all what you need including microwave, kettle, oven, automatic washing machine.
One bedroom has king bed with bathtub and the other room has king bed also with small TV.
Location was not accurate however the owner was very helpful and responded quickly to guide us to the location.
It was on the Main Street so it is noisy at late night however location very near to istiklal street around 2-3 min walk.
The owners were very nice, helpful and available once you need them.
Overall It’s worth it👍

I was travelling to Istanbul for the first time that too with family including two kids 7&12. Jundo and his co host Iso were very helpful and helped made our stay very comfortable.
They helped arrange for airport pick up and drop off, which was very helpful since we arrived very late in the night and the driver knew exactly where to take us.
Their place is very centrally located with easy access to public transport like bus and metro. Taksim square and istiklal street are very nearby and the other main attractions are not too far either.
The main road in front can be a bit noisy at night but otherwise the apartment was very homely and clean.
Highly recommended for travellers looking for a nice , safe and private space in Istanbul.

We just stayed here for four nights and had a great stay. The place was clean, walking distance to taksim square , metro etc
Our host was great, he was super fast in responding on everything. The directions for check in, Wi-Fi everything was well organized and easy.
The only issue was the noise from the street at night till very late. Despite that, I personally would stay here again.

We had a pleasant stay at Jundo’s place. The Airbnb was exactly as described and overall everything went smoothly. The host was always easy to reach and responded quickly, which was very helpful. The apartment was clean and tidy.
Overall, it was a good stay and absolutely fine for the price. Thank you!

We had a great stay! Everything was clean and exactly as described. The host was very friendly, easy to reach, and always helpful. The location was excellent as well. I can highly recommend this place and would definitely book it again! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

description: Very close to seaside

reviews.text: This is a great place for a long-term visit to Istanbul, I really enjoyed my two-week stay in this quiet part of Altintepe neighborhood. This large private room in a 3-bedroom apartment is perfect for budget travelers; awesome queen-sized bed, strong wi-fi, complete kitchen, good shower with a bathtub, washing machine, and a super host that keeps everything clean. The apartment is a 15-minute walk to Bagdat Cadde, the hip bar/shopping street, a 10-minute walk to Marmaray train station and Bostanci ferry to go to downtown Istanbul (Taksim, Sultanahmet) and E-9 bus stop for Sabiha (SAW) airport, and a 5-minute walk to grocery stores, restaurants, and Kizilay Red Crescent hospital for your PCR test. Excellent value.

Hello to all future quests:) if you are reading this - you are lucky! Because you’ve found best accommodation ever in Istanbul! Actually, this place is not only about for sleep and rest, this is real soul of Turkey. Mert is fantastic host I’ve ever seen with good sense of humour, he’s so smart and can talk with you many different things! You will love Istanbul more because of Mert :) I’ve stayed for one month I I felt like I am at home. There is everything for living in room and in flat, clean and comfortable. District is also very good, there a lot of cafes with good prices (not tourist price), subway station is only 7 mins walk and it’s fast and direct way to city center. I’m so happy to be in that place! Thank you Mert you are amazing!!! Don’t even think - just book and be happy as me! Cheers!

If you are looking for a quiet and safe place, to feel a local hospitality, it will be a ideal offer for you. The home located in a near public transportation, just a 5-10 min walking distance, Bostanci area. The rooms are big and clean, as described by host.
Mert is a very benevolent and sympathetic person, who care about all details for your stay, i also would like to recomend him

My stay at Merts place was thoroughly enjoyable. The Apartment is spacious, offering exactly things as per the description: a bedroom and a living room. I had my absolute privacy, but at the same time had a fabulous interaction with the host. You can talk about many things with him. He is really nice!. The breakfast you can make whatever you feel like as Mert has all the stuff in his refrigerator. Mert takes personal care and makes sure things are maintained in a clean way. The location is unbeatable, in the midst of all places, close to harbour as well as metro subway.
The best part is that he is always available and keeps in touch through whatsapp and phone call. He is indeed a very good and caring host as he personally came to receive me at the harbour when is was snow storm in Istanbul.
On the whole to have one of the most friendliest BnB option in Bostanci, you don't have to think twice to book this place.

Halis is a great host, always responded quickly to my questions. The room was comfortable, clean and located in a quiet residential area. About 15 minutes walk from metro and ferry stop. I would definitely stay there again!
