description:
Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish, and fully furnished new flat!

Everything you need is in this cozy 2+1 Scandinavian-style flat; it’s totally yours!

Perfect for long stays and digital nomads (100 mbps wifi).

Located in a quiet and safe residential area in the Anatolian side. Close to metro and bus stations (3-5 minutes walking distance). A big shopping mall, parks and seaside are nearby.

It has a rich library for guests who would enjoy and keep our books safe 🪷.

reviews.text: We were really lucky to stay in Duygu's apartment! It is very cozy, warm and nice place to live in! Everything was provided by Duygu! There is a great 5g internet which is the best we've experienced during staying in Turkey! A bookcase full of English books😍 TV with Netflix and access to internet. A comfortable and soft bed. A really good heating system and very easy to use. Everything is new and very clean! Duygu was always reachable she helped us with any questions we had. The area is very quiet and save, there are a lot of cute cats around and nice neighbors. There is BIM supermarket and a few shops within 1 min walk, Carrefour around 20 min walk, the sea and a wonderful park is about 30 min walk or you can take a bus to get there as well. There is a metro station within 5 min walk. And a big shopping mall within 10 min walk which was really cool, coffee in Starbucks and sunsets with sea view from Penguin store are amazing! We fell in love with this apartment and Duygu as a host, hope to stay there next time we visit Istanbul❤️

I was right at home when I checked in. The place is cozy and comfortable. New furniture and very modern appliances. Walking distance to Metro, Grocery Stores and a few nice cafe's.
The only thing which was not very comfortable was the noise isolation of the flat. Somehow I was able to hear people upstairs. I knew when they were vacuuming to clean the floor, or even coughing.
Other than that, I highly suggest this place.
Everything was as described, the airbnb was clean and had everything we needed☺️ it‘s pretty dark in the flat though. The communication was flawless. We would recommend!

I enjoyed every second of my stay in Duygu's apartment. It is located in a nice area close to a metro station and a big shopping mall. There are several parks within walking distance as well, one of them near the coastline.
The apartment has everything you need and even more, such as a grill/toaster, a small library and a study.
The apartment design is remarkable. It's stylish and very cozy thanks to the light colors. However, the walls are thin and do not block the outside noises very well, so earplugs are a must for sensitive sleepers.
Since Duygu was out of town, she told me in advance that another woman will be meeting me and helping with check-in and check-out, who doesn't speak English. This was not a problem because she was able to translate my messages. She showed me everything in the apartment - it was easy to understand without words.
Duygu stayed in touch and replied quickly whenever I had any questions.
10/10 highly recommend!

Firstly the host is very very friendly, kind and helpful. She always answered quickly. They have everything you need here. It feels like home and very cozy. House is very warm, internet is so fast. You can work here just like it is your office. The washing machine especially is awesome. Safe and great neighborhood. Me and my girlfriend rented this house for long time stay, and it is definitely a place you can live, just like it is your own house. There is also a garage if you have a car. The metro is super close, you can easily travel around in no time. Markets are so close. You got a little garden which you can go from the saloon door and there is a very cute cat there waiting for your interest :). I can definitely recommend this great house to everybody.

description: Its Center of İstanbul. Decent environment. Middle of historycal peninsula. Near of the bosphorus, some historycal places like Sultanahmet, Hagia sophia, Golden horn, Eminönü, Grand Bazzar. 5 min to T1 tram line and near of the Yenikapı metro/marmaray station. And also close to metrobus line. You can go easily everywhere you want. Near of the some big hospitals (5 min to Çapa and 15 min to Cerrahpaşa Hospitals). Have WiFi, kitchen experiences. You'll have an intern dr. homemate.

reviews.text:
In general, it is good for single guest to get shared unit with the owner. You with get shared shower room with one people only. Not like the other AirBnB host that you have to be aware that you can share the shower room with 7 people.
The Host:
He has quick respond. I book last minute, around 3am. Even though the host out of the city, he send the friend for the key and any complaint. He guide me the effective public transport from airport to the place
Accessibility:
You only need to walk around 5-10 minutes to Capa sehremini metro. Easy to find the food and groceries. The unit located at 2nd floor without lift, so you will not feel tired everyday using the stair.
Neighborhood:
You will find the turkish neighborhood around you which is good. Feeling the atmosphere of fans watching Galatasaray match in the neighborhood cafe. There are 2 Masjids very nearby, only 2 minute walking then if you are moslem easy for you for daily pray and Friday prayer.
Little bit improvement need to do during my stay thats why i give 4 star, like the hanger for jet shower, need trash bin. I believe it will be solved for the coming tenant

Ahmet and his friend are wonderful hosts. I was exhausted and coming in the early morning and they even made me a place to stay before my check in time. They were very hospitable and helpful. The room was clean and accurately described. I would happily stay here again. I felt like a guest not just a client. It was wonderful
Ahmet is a reliable, punctual and responsive host. The location is pretty good. The free Wifi works fast. A lot of groceries nearby.

Accommodation was fine. Very cozy apartment. The hosts help me on everything. Location is also fine. You have all that you need in 10 minutes: shops, cafes, transports. So, I can recommend this apartment as one of the best variant in terms of price-quality ratio.

ahmad was very cooperative and helpful
the location of the house is in an excellent place and you have all the facilities nearby...
the experience was good

description:
Indulge in the exquisite allure of the ''Bestekar'' Apartment, a stunning abode that has been meticulously crafted and newly constructed in 2021.
You'll be greeted by stylish finishes and top-of-the-line appliances that are sure to make your stay comfortable and convenient. Each room is equipped with air conditioning to ensure that you have a cool stay.
Whether you're looking to relax or explore, the newly constructed ''Bestekar'' has everything you need to make the most of your stay.

reviews.text: This is a good option for a short stay, but I wouldn’t recommend it for more than a week. They do not provide most of daily necessities like other comparable airbnbs I have stayed at. The listing says it will have salt pepper oil, for instance, but none of them was available. I’m sure if I asked they would bring some, but the issue is the thoughtfulness of the host: it’s their job to ensure everything is as described.of course you can also purchase most anything from a variety of markets around, but they should really pay attention to how they equip the kitchen and the entire home. Location is good. Hosts are responsive and helpful, but this is very little for a lot of money.

The place was exactly as shown in the photos. It is so safe and private apartment. The apartment is modern and clean. There is a very nice cafe down the street and I think it is open until midnight. The place honestly worths what I have paid. Furthermore, I like that Homie’s team were so helpful when I needed a plug adapter, they immediately provided me with two! Thank you so much for your hosting & help.

The apartment is exceptionally clean and cozy, with a fantastic location close to shops, restaurants, and public transportation. It’s fully equipped with everything you need for comfortable living—for example, a modern kitchen and cozy living area. Highly recommended for a hassle-free stay!

Overall nice stay here. A few things to note, it’s a very hilly area without much public transportation. The mosque is super close so you will definitely hear the prayer call at 10pm/4am. Theres a pretty good corner store right by the apartment that has a good selection of food/groceries.
The place was as described and pictured. Bathroom was a tad smelly like mildew. Internet was fast for our work calls!

The place is good for those who want to explore the city on a budget (especially the more local areas), yet looking for more convenient amenities, in a safe and quiet neighborhood.
The place was very clean and comfortable, with local art paintings which gave the place more warmth and texture.
All the amenities were listed and working great.
Although the neighborhood was quiet and safe, there was not much to do nearby; you have a very few small restaurants and cafes. The Cevahir mall is up north which would take nearly 20 minutes to reach by foot, but I would recommend to go south to downtown Beşiktaş (40 minutes by foot), with crowded local cafes and restaurants that stays open up until midnight. Downtown Nişantaşi is nearly 40 minutes by foot to the southwest, with its more refined restaurants and luxurious stores.

description: Enjoy a stylish experience in this centrally located place. It is within walking distance to the city center stores and easily accessible to transportation, and you can walk to the hospital, shopping mall and bazaar center.

reviews.text: Unfortunately, this was a disappointing stay. The apartment was extremely hot, to the point that it felt like an oven. Although a fan was provided, it had almost no effect. Opening the windows wasn’t a solution because the traffic noise outside was incredibly loud, making it difficult to rest or sleep. During the summer, I don’t think this apartment is comfortable to stay in without proper air conditioning. I also found hair on the bed, which made it seem like the bedding hadn’t been cleaned properly. Considering the high price, I expected a much better experience.

The host is very quick to respond and assist. The building has lift and cameras and felt very safe and also the building is very clean. Walking distance to tube, supermarkets, mosque, restaurants etc. the only struggle I guess is the building situated on a very busy road where you can hear constant car horns from early mornings and also in late afternoons (rush hours). I guess it’s a cultural thing for drivers to constantly horn to each other for every little thing unlike UK 🇬🇧 where using car horn is only for dangerous situations.
Toplu ulaşıma yakın konumda, temiz bir ev. Giriş çıkış işlemleri rahat bir şekilde yapılıyor. Ev sahibi ilgili ve hızlı cevap veriyor.

Öncelikle ev gerçekten konum olarak çok iyi ve kolay bulanacak bir konumda ev gayet geniş ferah ve sıcak. Avm var çok yakınında. İletişime geçtiğinizde her an yardımcı olan bir ev sahibi bu konuda hiç bir sorun yok.
Ancak temizlik konusunda biraz eksiği var yerler ve tv ünitesi ciddi anlamda tozluydu.
Gokay’s place was very clean, great location the host was very responsive.

description: Comfy, lovely apartment with brand new furnishing and warm ambience in the heart of Istanbul. It is located a short walk from Taksim Square. The bus and metro stations are 5 mins walk. Enjoy acting like a local at this stylish well-decorated apt.

reviews.text:
I had a great experience in Istanbul at Deniz's apartment!!! I will describe it in two ways; 1. Accommodation and 2. "Deniz" as my favorite host ever :) The flat was immaculate, clean, furnishings were super new, kitchen and bathroom were well equipped and looked just like the pictures. Location is convenient and refreshingly off the typical tourist track, but still only 5 minutes walking distance to Taksim with plenty of great restaurants and architecture. The flat also has a small but common used terrace up on the roof. I had spent lovely time during sunset. Just to relax after a long and exhausted day of walking. Also very easy access to public transportation.

Apart from the accommodation Deniz and her husband were so helpful during our stay. All of our questions were answered by the detailed instructions she provided at the time of booking. After we booked the apartment she sent us a guidebook which is prepared by her local tips about what to do, where to eat, etc. That was gorgeous! They were always ready to answer our instant questions via Whatsapp group, established the day we arrived there. Having the opportunity that someone local and friendly are backing you up at anytime for any issue makes you so feel so safe and comfortable.

I will definitely keep the flat on the list, and highly recommend it. But furthermore I will keep Deniz as a friend.

This apartment completely lives up to how it appears on the website: spacious, clean and impeccably decorated it felt like a second home. The kitchen was well equipped and the beds extremely comfortable. Deniz and her husband Ercan were so kind to us, nothing was ever too much trouble, even when we managed to lock ourselves out! The roof terrace is also fantastic for enjoying a bit of outdoor space and watching the sun go down with a beer - we didn't once encounter anyone else using the terrace so it felt like it was all ours!

The location is great, just minutes from Taksim metro, it was easy to get everywhere and explore the city but also away from the main tourist drag - exactly what I like! I can't recommend this flat highly enough to anyone who is thinking of booking. Thank you Deniz and Ercan!

This is our first time in airbnb, we are sad that we had spoiled our previous visits to Istanbul by staying in hotels. We were welcomed By Deniz very friendly on our arrival (which was quite late time, we shocked, we did not expected a welcome at flat!). Flat is perfectly decorated and spotless clean, we found more that we need for our stay, well known brand pillows, and linens, wireless internet, led tv, full cooking facilities and some complimentary drinks and foods at fridge, what else we looking for? i believe facilities are suitable for even longer stays. We travel to Istanbul nearly every month for 2-3 days, and we know where we will stay at our next stays if Deniz also accept us. Thank you Deniz for perfect stay, and looking forward to see you next month.

The apartment was clean and comfortable, the location is great with few minutes walking to the bus or metro, also Taksim square is just six minutes from the apartment. There is a number if supermarkets around the area and restaurants as well. Deniz was very friendly and helpful, check-in was simple and Deniz was very welcoming.

Deniz and her husband are really a super host! they are very welcoming to there guests. She was so helpful and friendly and always had time for questions, She had guides books and maps which you can use as well. The house is very well located. You are in Taksim Square, center of attractions in a few minutes. The flat is spacious, comfortable and very clean. You have everything you need. There is airconditioner that saves you in hot weather. The neighborhood is calm and local. I stayed there for one month with 2 kids,I would like to stay here when I come back again. I would definitely recommend Deniz place to other travelers. Much love from Oslo

description: Hello everyone. Our room is in Kadıköy, 1 minute walk from the port. There is music at night as there is a bar under the building. Please be aware of this. Please feel free to ask all your questions and requests. I will be happy to answer.

reviews.text: Serhat’s apartment was exactly as described. It is very simple and clean, and in an excellent location for both Kadikoy/Moda and the main tourist areas of Istanbul. If you just need a room for the night at a good price this is a great option. The pier for the ferry to Karakoy and Eminönü is a 5 minute walk away. As others have noted, there is an issue with noise from the local bars/clubs until about 2-4am (depending on the night), but if you’re from a large city yourself it’s easy to ignore. And if you’re looking for bars then it’s a great location. If you’re used to silence at night then maybe not! Serhat is very responsive and clear in communications, and the check in and out were flexible and easy.

Bu yorumu sadece küçük bir öneri olarak değerlendirmenizi rica ederim. Konum açısından gayet iyiydi ve ev, fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Ancak evle ilgili birkaç küçük önerim var. Öncelikle mutfakta en azından bir bulaşık deterjanı bulundurulabilir. Ayrıca televizyon kanalları çekmiyor. Evde Wi-Fi mevcut, ancak televizyona bağlanıp YouTube izlemek istediğimizde ciddi derecede kasma yaşanıyor.
Bunların dışında ev genel olarak temizdi ve yatak oldukça konforluydu. Ev biraz sade kalmış, boş alanlar daha iyi değerlendirilebilir.

The host communicated well and was responsive to any concerns or questions I had. The location is close to Kadikoy ferry and metro station. The negative is that the neighborhood is a bit loud at night as there is bar across the street and if you're a light sleeper it probably will not be good. It seems like the person before my stay was a heavy smoker because my sheets smelled like cigarettes. The host was kind enough to come the next day to change the sheets and the curtains to help remove the lingering smell.
It was a comfortable place for me to do work and a convienent location for me to get around Istanbul. Good size for one or two people to spend a few days traveling.

Decent place, priced high. Doesn’t match how “welcoming” it’s pictured to be. The entrance was tricky to begin with, felt like the door frame was going to come off, broken/non working light fixtures, hair dryer didn’t work, wasn’t provided water, let alone pictured snacks.
Host is responsive on messages and was kind enough to let me check out half an hour late.

Apart konum ev sahibi iyi ama ütü yok çamaşır makina yok mutfak eşyaları cok yetersiz süpürge yok temizlik bez yok yatak odasında karinca var ikinci katta kaldim ona rağmen alt kattan müzik sesleri geliyor yatinca rahatsiz olabilirsiniz bu eksikler tamamlanirsa gayet güzel bir apart evsahini iyi

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family. Our apartment has its own garden. Our apartment has been newly renovated and is very clean. Our apartment has all the accessories to cook. You can definitely stay peacefully and happily.

reviews.text:
We found Cem's place to be located in a very nice district, near shops, restaurants, and walkable distances from main attractions in Istanbul.
Cem was very helpful with the instructions, helped us at our arrival, and even made the effort to save us a parking spot in the busy street. He also installed a very comfortable crib for our small baby to sleep.
The place was very clean, small but smart, and with all the essentials.
I strongly recommend staying at Cem's.

Great lower ground floor flat in the heart of the European quarter of Istanbul. Easy walk to most places and downhill to tram stop that takes you over the Gelata bridge to other tourist hotspots.
Really quiet flat with a lovely quiet back garden area. The garden is in shade in the morning but in lovely broken sunlight in afternoon. Great for sitting out and relaxing.
Good Wi-Fi and smart tv. Kitchen hob with pans and fridge washing machine. Good shower.
Nice double bedroom with door opening to garden.
As with a lot of Istanbul it’s a walk up a steep hill to the front door. The directions to the flat are not quite accurate and the best advice is that it’s two doors up the hill from the Fragment hotel,which has a very good rooftop restaurant.
All in all good value for money place to stay in Istanbul.
Perfect location, extremely kind and helpful host, clean and cozy apartment. Everything is just like on photos. We would definitely recommend it to anyone

Very professionally managed apartment. Responds came within minutes every time I wrote them. Apartment was overall very clean. Furniture not new but in very good shape and spotless clean. Apartment is in top location. walking distance to Tophane, Cihangir, Taksim, Karakoy all top touristic places filled with trendy places. Despite being close to everything, very quiet. No car noise, no street noise. I found the apartment a bit small but for the price and location I think it's reasonable.

Cem’s apartment is located in a quiet area within 5-7 minutes walk from the embankment and at the same time 10-15 minutes walk from Taksim/Istiklal. The apartments are fairly small, but very clean; bed-cloth and towels are new. There is a private inner garden with a tree, a table and a set of two chairs and a spacious couch.
The XIX century house itself is quite atmospheric. LOTS of restaurants, cafes and shops nearby, including a huge Carrefour Gourme with excellent assortment.
Cem was very welcoming and left the exact instructions for the taxi driver to take us here.
Definitely good value for money!

description:
You'll have a great time at this comfortable place to stay.
Apartment close to the metro and airport 1+1 apartment with a terrace in a family building
Entire home to yourself

reviews.text: Cebrail Beyin evinde 2.kalışım. Herzaman çok yardımcı ve hızlı cevap veren bir ev sahibi. Ayrıca ev oldukça rahat. İşinize yarıyacak her şey düşünülmüş. Temizlik de oldukça iyiydi. Bu konuma yolunuz düşerse tercih edebilirsiniz.

Her şey harikaydı. Ev oldukça temizdi. Ayrıca oldukça genişti. İhtiyacınız olabilecek her ayrıntı düşünülmüş. Konumu iyiydi. T4 tramvay hattına yürüyerek 8 dk. Aile apartmanının en üst katında bulunuyor. Biraz merdiven çıkmanız gerekiyor. Host da oldukça ilgiliydi.
Her şey mükemmeldi, ev fotoğraftaki gibiydi, gayet temiz ve modern bir evdi. İhtiyacınız olabilecek her şey ev sahibi tarafından karşılanmıştı ve Cebrail bey çok ilgiliydi. Herkese öneririm.
Very comfortable and cozy apartment, super clean, fully furnitured, it is a good choice for staying here for 1 days or even for weeks
Öncelikle ev temizdi, fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibi aynısı çok sıcak bir ev. Cebrail bey her konuda yardımcı oldu ve hızlı dönüş aldık. Çok memnun kaldık kesinlikle tavsiye ederim :)

description: My suites are in Sultanahmet, the most beautiful and most historical area of Istanbul. There are 5 or 10 minutes walking distance to historical places. Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar, Hippodrome, shops, markets, tram stations, boat and bus stops.

reviews.text:
We had an excellent stay in this ideally located accommodation, just a five-minute walk from Sultanahmet.
Everything was easily accessible, including the tram, restaurants, grocery stores, markets, and the main tourist attractions.
The room was very clean, comfortable, and matched the description perfectly. The host was kind, polite, helpful, and trustworthy. He also helped us arrange a taxi to the airport, which we greatly appreciated.
My mother and I felt comfortable, warmly welcomed, and safe throughout our stay. The location is very convenient for exploring Istanbul. I highly recommend this place and would gladly stay here again on a future visit.

Our stay with Cavit was very good. All staff were very friendly, it operates more like a hotel with 24/7 staff and an extremely friendly and diligent cleaning lady. It was very clean and exactly like the photos. The laundry includes one shared washer and dryer for the whole building. They were great and super helpful in the heat of Istanbul, but we wished they were a bit faster than 3 hour cycles! The cleaning lady without us even asking told us to go have fun and finished our laundry for us and even folded it! Great location, although it was hard to spot the first day (it isn’t marked clearly and we arrived after 3am). But it is about an 8 minute walk to Sultanahmet mosque, which is on the tram. And many surrounding properties are on a steep hill to get there, whereas this one is not. It’s a much softer hill and way easier to navigate each day. I would recommend if you’re looking for value!
I recommend staying here. Its exactly as pictured, clean, staff is responsive and helpful 24/7 its also close to many main locations, its worth the price.

My father and I stayed in Cavit’s place over a week and it was a good stay. The staff members were very helpful, the housekeeping was done daily, the room was warm and the water in the shower was always very nice. There is a kitchen where we were able to cook dinners and breakfasts, there was a kettle and a mini-fridge in the room. The wifi connection was good and stable. The beds were comfy. The location is convenient: 10 min to the tram station that gets you to the main attractions. The downside of the property is that the windows of the room come out to the narrow inner yard of the house and because of this there is almost no daylight in the room and the air is quite stuffy. Apart from this - for sure consider the 4:30 am everyday prayer coming from the mosque, which might wake you up but that is common in muslim countries. This is a good place to stay if you plan to spend most of your day in the city and have a good rest at night.

First of all : all staff is very friendly and respectful and easy to communicate, and very helpful I forgot thier names
The property space is very good
The location of the property is also very good
You can feel very safe and the staff give you what you need..
….

There is no kitchen or any electrical stove in the property
Its just a room with sofa and table with chairs
And bathroom
So when I rent it I thought its an apartment
But actually it’s more like a room in hotel actually

description:
My apartment is located in the most central part of Istanbul, 5 minutes from Esteghlal Street and 10 minutes from Taksim Square.
Access to public transportation is very convenient.
Bus 1 minute / Tasim metro 10 minutes / Shishane metro 15 minutes / Dolmush 5 minutes
I will guide you to visit all the touristic and attractive areas of Istanbul.
If you are planning a family trip, I look forward to hosting you.

reviews.text: Very comfortable location, everything near, safe and clean. Very fast responding and friendly host

Notre séjour était juste magnifique. Kamran était très réactif et flexible et nous a laissé faire le check in avant 14h.
L'appartement est juste comme les photos et l'amabilité de Kamran l'a rendu plus agréable. Il répondait rapidement aux messages et nous a ramené tout ce dont on avait besoin.
Le seul petit bémol est pour l'emplacement, la ruelle dans laquelle se situe l'appartement est dans une pente très inclinée, donc faites gaffe pour les non sportifs ou si vous avez beaucoup de bagages comme c'était le cas pour nous, mais même avec ça Kamran nous a aidé avec les valises car il n'y avait pas d'ascenseur et nous étions au 3ème étage.
Un autre point positif sur l'emplacement est que c'est hyper sécurisé et très proche du boulevard Istiqlal et Taqsim square (7 min a pied) et juste à côté y'a des supermarchés , petite épicerie , boulangerie, pharmacie..
Bref, je recommende vivement et on reviendrai sûrement lors de notre prochain séjour.

Ev mukemmel temiz, gereken her sey var, rahatligi super.
Ev sahibi zamaninda lazim olan seyde hemen yardimci olurdu.
Mahalle cok kirli, karisik, karabalik.
Everything was clear, clean and the same as explained. It is just 3-4 minutes walk to istiklal street. Well recommended.

Ive been to many places and this is one of the best place i have ever been I stayed 10 days .quick response . Good location (heart of Istanbul) clean apartment . In total everything was great and i will back soon again . Thank you Tala for everything

description: Villa Galley is an 10 room facility. This room is for 2 people and is the smallest room of our facility. Our room sizes vary and we can accomodate up to 4 persons in a room. Please check availability of the other rooms if the one you are looking for is unavailable/booked. The rooms are identical in terms of equipment.

reviews.text: Galley Hotel is located near the sea and there is a great view for anyone that picks the balcony room. Our short 2 night stay there was fantastic and boosted by the helpfulness of the host. An elevator would have helped a lot but the receptionist will assist you if you ask them. We look forward to coming here again!
Everything was as described and we had a nice stay! Really good location of the apartment and also the staff was really friendly and helpful!

Can is a great guy really helpful and speaks good English so that made it easier to communicate. About the place well the location is not so ideal in terms of navigating and plus it’s at downhill so you will have to walk all the way up to main spots like grand bazar aya Sophia etc. place was really clean which is plus point. The room we stayed was very compact. Overall for the amount I paid was justified.
Very nice location, quite central.... Water kettle was dirty but they changed it with a new one easily. The room is nice, big enough...Bathroom smells a bit musty but nothing bad!

Very welcoming host. Clean bed and breakfast style hotel. Breakfast included. Can was welcoming, made me coffee, and was quick to help me with whatever I needed. He definitely puts forth an extra effort to make his guests have a good experience.

description:
Luxury suites are residences. Our apartment has a jacuzzi on the balcony.
Our guests can use the hotel facilities. There is an additional fee for the pool, gym, and sauna.
The apartment has a separate parking lot and it is free of charge.
The place is directly on the seafront and has a uniquely beautiful sea view.
The metro is within walking distance
This apartment has an extraordinary sea view where you can enjoy the sunset from your couch and bedroom.

reviews.text:
Where do i start honestly.
1. The location isnt the best - 30 mins away from all good sightseeing locations and with traffic it can go up to 50 mins to get to The Blue Mosque.
2. Car parking spot will always change everytime sometimes you are parking at number 30 and another time it would be 60 then continues to change.
3. Inside the accomodation its smaller than expected and very humid and hot the underfloor heating just never will switch off and you will not be able to sleep because aircon only powers in summer time.
4. I had to do deep cleaning of the place myself and the washing machine and dryer can take half the day for a load of washing.
5. The sofa is electric but not comfortable at all. literally your back will begin to hurt.
6. Dont even open the windows you will constantly hear traffic so loud and it wont ever stop even at 3am in the morning.
7. wifi can stop working in the middle of the night. Netflix doesnt work in bedroom and the TV is too old.

Emrah was an amazing host and his place was fully worth the amount we paid for it. The view from the balcony is just amazing.
I just asked Emrah if the tap water is drinkable or not and within 30 mins he got us two 5 litre bottles of water( on the house). Very considerate person.
The airbnb was clean and tidy and had all the amenities mentioned. It can sleep 3 people easily. But practically, it’s good for 2.
There is a taxi stand right below the building so getting a taxi was never a problem.
Only 15-20 mins drive to old town and galata area. So it’s not that far from touristy places.
There is a huge area with restaurants and grocery store 10 mins walk away.
In all, really good experience.

I am absolutely thrilled with our stay at this house.
From the moment we arrived, Emrah made all the difference with his attentiveness and kindness. Always attentive to our needs and responsive, he replied to our messages instantly, and his 24/7 availability gave us true peace of mind. His professionalism and kindness were exemplary: he even helped us recover our suitcase lost by Turkish Airlines, going above and beyond to make everything perfect.
The house itself is a true gem, perfectly true to the photos and description, with a breathtaking view.
The area is quiet, ideally located near taxi and train stops, and the cleanliness is impeccable. Luxury is everywhere, crowned by the jacuzzi with a sea view.
You can reach the sea in 5 minutes walk
A real dream moment!
I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone looking to experience something exceptional and unforgettable."

Ev hem temizlik hem de düzen açısından oldukça özenliydi ve fotoğraflardakiyle tamamen uyumluydu. Konumu ve manzarası beklentimizin üzerindeydi. Emrah Bey son derece ilgili, nazik ve profesyonel bir ev sahibi, her konuda hızlıca destek oldu.Kendisine tesekkur ediyoruz, gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

I had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. What really stood out was the host — they went above and beyond to make sure I had everything I needed and were super helpful throughout my stay. Their communication was quick and thoughtful, which made everything so easy. Highly recommend staying here!

description: Enjoy a practical, sweet, warm, stylish experience in this centrally located place.

reviews.text:
I had an amazing stay at Doğan's place! It's truly incredible, and one of the nicest places I've found in Istanbul.
– The location is PERFECT, just 30 sec away from the center of Bebek, a short walk (1-3 min) from all the best shops and restaurants.
– The apartment is lovely. It's compact, but cozy and stylish. Doğan made sure everything was taken care of – sheets, kitchen utensils, coffee, soaps/shampoos..
– The decoration is so tastefully done. Doğan has such an eye for detail. Everything is clean and comfortable. The design is of the highest quality and style. Even the lobby is as if you're walking into a museum.
Doğan was also very responsive to my questions and requests, and made sure that I had everything I needed.
I would highly recommend his Airbnb to anyone looking for a great place to stay in Istanbul.

Overall, a very enjoyable week-long stay.
Excellent communication with Doğan both before and during my stay, plus met on check-in.
The first-floor apartment is stylish and comfortable. Good cooking facilities. Excellent wifi. Particularly liked the attractive bathroom.
Plenty of natural light, with windows onto fairly quiet streets at both ends of the apartment. All windows have excellent coverings to block light as required.
I liked the location - leafy, up-market Bebek is close to the city centre on the European side, but feels somewhat secluded. The apartment is a very short walk from buses going along the waterfront (22 and 40H); alternatively, it is a steep walk uphill to the Boğaziçi Üniversitesi İstasyonu metro station.
A small supermarket is next door - some noise issues with early morning deliveries. A branch of Sok supermarket is a minute away. Other grocery options are available in Arnavutköy, a lovely fifteen-minute walk along the waterfront.

I had a wonderful stay. The apartment looked exactly like the photos—very clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed. The host was incredibly kind and respectful, always friendly, and very accommodating with flexible check-in and check-out. It made the whole experience even better. I would definitely choose this place again next time I’m in Istanbul.
Great accommodation - clean, spacious, good amenities. The pictures are accurate, price is very appropriate. Dogan is very responsive and accommodating as a host. I would definitely stay again!

Merkezi konumu, rahat ve güvenli olması, evin modern ve temiz olması beklentimin çok üstündeydi. Doğan beyin yardımseverliği ve anlayışlılığı da, bir dahaki ziyaretimde yine aynı daireyi tercih etmem için başka bir sebep…

description: I made this little apartment for romantic girls. You can spend fun moments on the swing for your pleasant travel plan in this apartment with hand-painted, flower and bird pictures.

reviews.text:
Nice little room at Kadikoy, 5 minutes to ferries/metro, Moda district, 15min to big shopping center and Marmaray - location is perfect.
Helpful instructions to access the apartment. There's no lift in the building and the stairs are narrow so it could be uncomfortable with large luggage (backpacks are totally ok). Everithing is like on photos - we enjoyed the place although it is quite small, but on the other hand - everything is on hand)
Missed second big towel, wall hook in the bathroom and kitchen towel.
Everithing else was great

Nice location, close to the metro and port, close to the restaurants and shops, but not in the noisy middle of it.
The apartment was clean, and the check in instructions were clear and easy to follow. It was a tiny apartment, but rather well equipped with appliances for its size.
Cons of the appartment was spiran and steap stairs that goes up to the 2nd floor. It is especially difficult first and last days when you have your bags with you.
Walls are thin and doesn't stop noise much. I even heard some snoring from other appartments.
Worst part for me was the bed, pillows and cover. What separates good and bad hotel and apartment is that. This could be much improved.
The apartment is worth for short stay od 1-3 nights max. I wouldn't recomend staying longer.

Konumu çok iyiydi sadece o bölgede park yeri sorunu var fakat kaldığımız yerin hemen yakınında otopark var. Biraz pahalı ama en güvenlisi o. Konum bilgisini uygulamadan rahatlıkla anlayabiliyorsunuz. İçine gelince her ihtiyacımı karşılayabilecek ekipman mevcuttu. En önemlisi temiz bir daireydi. Tek eksik terlik olabilir. Bende almayı unutmuşum o yönden eksiklik çektim diyebilirim. Onun haricinde ayak havlusu, kurutma makinesi, duş jeline kadar düşünülmüş bir odaydı. Bir de duvarları inanılmaz inceydi ben yan dairedeki bütün sesleri duyabiliyordum. Sessiz bir yer arıyorsanız burası size göre değil. Tuğba hanıma istediğim zaman ulaştım. Arkadaşlarıma tavsiye edebileceğim ve benim tekrar konaklama yapabileceğim bir yerdi.

I would like to first of all thank the host for the very accurate description of everything.
The flat was clean, had all the amenities listed and was located in a decent location.
The flat is suitable for those who have a short trip to Istanbul and want a clean place to stay the night, since you cannot move inside the flat very much, it is quite tiny, and of course that makes it cost-effective which was a great choice for us :)
All in all, would recommend the place for sure, can't fault.

Tek sorun kokuyor olmasıydı, nem desem değil rutubet desem değil evin ne koktuğunu algılamakta zorlandık. Temizlik anlamında da bir sorun göremedik. Onun dışında konum harika yakında otopark olması bizim için büyük bir artıydı. Rıhtıma 5 dk yürüme mesafesinde. Koku olmasa tekrar konaklama yapacağım bir yer olurdu, fotoğraflarda görüldüğünden biraz daha küçüktü, biz evi yalnızca uyumak için kullandığımız için sorun olmadı ama uzun konaklamalara uygun olduğunu düşünmüyorum. Yinede ev sahibine teşekkür ederiz..

description:
-Near by to Galataport
-Close walking distance to all public transportations
-In the center of city
-A neighborhood that where is silent, peaceful, cozy
-It’s pleasure for us to accommodate you in our pretty house.

reviews.text:
The apartment itself was really good - very clean and light. The utilities worked well (hot water, lavatory etc). Beds were comfortable and clean. All the necessary kitchen utilities were there. The location was peaceful and quiet, though close to the touristic attractions. The tram station is close.
The things that didn't bother us, but may be important for other people - the district is nice, but has hilly landscape, so it may be difficult for someone. The apt is 3 floor and the stairs are quite steeper.
The things I lack - first of all communication with the host. The check-in would be easier if it were some instructions. Though the host's brother helped.
The TV wasn't working and no one bothered to fix it , though we asked. The iron was a mess - broken and unsafe, and the host just ignored my request to replace it or lend us another one for a couple of days.
Overall impression is good, generally I would recommend the place. But I would advise the host to be more involved.

I really enjoyed my stay and never regretted choosing this place. The location is perfect, one of the best in Istanbul for tourists, without a doubt.
Bunyamin was super helpful, the house was clean, and the Wi-Fi worked well. The only issue is the furniture. I think it would be worth investing some money in upgrading the furniture and then charging a little more.
The sofa is broken, the dining set feels very cheap, and the mattress is old uncomfortable. Sorry for being so frank, but I truly believe you can make this place amazing simply by upgrading the furniture. It has great potential

The location is great, very close to all main landmarks, nice cafes and shops. But there are couple of things to know - the house is old and you have to be ready for random water outages- when I came there was no water at all and I had to wait till the end of the next day to get a shower. And the same thing happened in 3 days again. But it’s now a host’s fault for sure. The kitchen is not well equipped, knives definitely need some sharpening, an oven - some cleaning and towels and bed sheets had a strong smell of cigarettes. Also there is a mosque nearby and it wakes you up with a prayer very early in the morning.

Host Bünyamin was very responsive, he help us book taxi from airport to the location before arrival which helped us a lot. Place was as seen in photos and checkin was easy. Great location, 5mins from T1 and most of the locations are accessible by walk or a quick trip in T1. We missed to bring the european charger and Bünyamin gave me his charger head. Room was quite spacious for a family of three. Will definitely visit again. Thanks much for hosting us Bünyamin. The house has all the needed appliances from oven to airfryer to dryer and fridge . Beautiful neighbourhood with cafes,restaurants and super market close by.

I like the Cihangir area and its surroundings. Yes, this area is full of hills and stairs, but at the same time, it is one of the vital hearts of Istanbul. The apartment is located in its quiet part. The road, although it passes under the windows, but with little traffic and almost does not bother.
The apartment itself consists of a bedroom with a large wardrobe, a bathroom, a living room with a lot of wardrobes and a kitchen. The living room and kitchen are separated by a wall. The kitchen is equipped with a dishwasher. A washing machine is also present. There is a small balcony.
The bed mattress is very soft. Too soft in my opinion. The electrical sockets are not very conveniently located. The Internet is stable and of good quality. In general, the apartment corresponds to the photos and description. Decent choice.

description: FAMILY RUN BUSINESS – 24 HOURS RECEPTION (3 minute distance) – FREE MINI BREAKFAST (Less than 3 minute distance) – 4MINS TO ISTIKLAL STREET – MARKETS & PATISSERIES VERY CLOSE – SAME FLAT IN THE PHOTO

reviews.text:
My friend and I loved staying here. The space was clean and comfortable. We were in walking distance to many things including a fantastic Himalayan Restaurant and several small grocery stores. The host was very responsive and organized our taxi from the airport and helped us get into the room.
Maybe there could be a few more kitchen utensils, cutting board, and a smaller pot, but otherwise we had no problems cooking.
Thanks for a great stay!

A nice studio apartment near Taksim, 15 minutes walking distance. The apartment was clean and matched the description well. The hosts are super good, very responsive and friendly. The young man working at the reception really helped me a lot in my need. It was exceptional. We had a nice stay for six days at the apartment. As mentioned, there were free mini-breakfast in the cafe Berry, which is nearby. Cofee/Tea/Juice, bread, jam, butter, olives and small portion of fruits.
The only downfall is the apartment is at the third floor with very inconvenient staircase. One need to struggle with a heavy luggage. Another thing, there were much noise in the streets at night, which was also mentioned in another review. It may be disturbing while sleeping.

I’m giving 2 stars due to poor staff response, a broken TV remote, and an unclean kitchen. On May 28, I reported the remote was broken and taped together. They said they’d bring a new one, but nothing happened until I checked out on June 4 — they simply forgot. Wi-Fi was also down on May 28. I messaged multiple times, and only in the evening next day did someone come to restart the router. On check-out, I found several dead cockroaches in a kitchen cabinet. I sent a photo, and their only reply was asking if it was like that at check-in — no apology. I unknowingly stayed 10 days with that filth. Amenities listed should work. If you offer a TV or Wi-Fi, they should function. If there’s an issue, it should be fixed or acknowledged. I would avoid this place in the future. I gave 2 stars instead of 1 only out of respect for the woman who served breakfast — she was very kind and hospitable.

The owner accused me of breaking the bed frame after I checked in for 5 minutes as I laid on the bed. The whole bed frame came off and started saying how I'd be doing the same thing in other places. Absolutely horrendous experience! I wouldn't recommend this to my worst enemy. Had to wait over an hour for the room to be cleaned and when entering the premises; the wood floor was broken near the kitchen area but the security was very nice. Overall avoid this place as the owner doesn't take responsibility for their properties and blames the guests without checking with their staff properly. Get your stuff together mate. Not a very friendly welcome to a beautiful city full of beautiful people.

Very clean and cozy apartment,everything was amazing bed, kitchen, bathroom everything except that the apartment in the third floor with no elevator but it wasn’t a problem for me, And the reception was super helpful i came at 8 am and asked him to check in early and they accepted with pleasure Thank you

description:
It is a 2+1 detached apartment; it is not a hotel or an apartment building. It is a quiet building. It is not an ordinary everyday apartment, but a meticulously and carefully prepared space where I will occasionally host my friends and family friends. 3min walk to the nearest metrobus station. You can check in to the apartment at any time after the check-in time with self check-in as if it were your own home.

The house is for 2 people, and as stated in the house rules, a third person cannot check in even if they are not staying.

reviews.text: Harika bir konaklama deneyimiydi. Ev, düzeni ve temizliğiyle üst düzeydi. Tüm detaylar özenle düşünülmüş, ihtiyaç duyulabilecek her şey eksiksizdi. Merkezi konumu sayesinde ulaşım çok rahattı. Emre Bey’in iletişimi ise gerçekten örnek alınacak seviyedeydi. Her şey kusursuz denebilecek noktadaydı , gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

Emre was a fantastic host! He was incredibly welcoming and always responded to messages quickly. The apartment was very clean and had a lovely view, even though it was on the ground floor. It gets plenty of sunlight and is conveniently located near Küçükçekmece Lake and the Marmara Sea. Transportation was also very easy. I highly recommend staying here!

Daire her şeyiyle harika; İBB Sosyal Tesisleri metrobüs durağına kısa bir yürüme mesafesinde, daha kısa bir yürüme mesafesinde ise golün sahili var. Giriş yapmak çok kolaydı. Ev harika kokuyor ve çok temiz ayrıca düzenli. Mutfakla ilgili arayabileceğiniz her şey mevcut. Yatak rahat, çarşaflar ve havlular temiz. Sıcak su kesintisiz akıyor. Tuvalet de tertemizdi. Rutubet vs yok. Harika bir yer kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.
Host was kind and responsive. Place was clean, in a nice location, and check-in/check-out was very easy!

Emre bey’in evinde ikinci kalışım. Yine aynı şekilde her şey kusursuzdu. Ev çok temiz. Banyo mükemmel titizlikte temizlenmiş, hiç bir leke pislik vs. Yoktu.
İçeri girdiğinizden itibaren evin kokusu vs mukemmeldi. Mutfakta hiç bir eksik yoktu.
Gönül rahatligiyla burda kalabilirsiniz. Emre bey çok yardimci oluyor her konuda

description:
Fully Furnished Luxury House in City Centre

25 meters to Osmanbey Metro Station- 5 mins to Taksim Square- Cevahir Shopping Mall and Nişantaşı Main Street

reviews.text: perfect location, clean, super host, but there were not bed linens for 4th person. it was only problem.
Nice clean comfortable place, feel like at home, very good location, near shopping area and Metro station all walking distances.

Good place just like was described on the app and what was shown on photos, great location with the metro station just a 2 minutes walk and you can just walk around the place with nice shops and good restaurants around the area. after all it was a great staying at the apartment.

I highly enjoyed my stay at Kerim’s place in Istanbul. The apartment is located in a very central area, so it's easy to get around. There's a lot of foot traffic in the area, so it's not the most quiet location, but there's so much to explore and do. The apartment itself is great. Very clean, homey, and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. I look forward to visiting again.

Sadece konum iyiydi ve sorularımıza hızlı yanıt aldık. Ev sahibi bence uzaktan bu işi yönettiği için aşağıdaki konulardan bir haber.
1- İçeri girer girmez kötü koku vardı ve bu koku hiç gitmedi.
2- Banyo kapısı kapanmıyor.
3- Banyoda tuvalet kağıdını koyacak bir yer yok.
4- Banyodaki sıvı sabun çok dandikti, orta kaliteli bir şey yeterli olurdu.
5- Dandikte olsa oteldekiler gibi kullan at terlik olmalıydı.
6- Salonda ara ara dıt dıt öten bir ses var, sanırım yangın için ama daha önce hiç bu kadar seslisini görmedim.
7- Ekstra bir battaniye koyulması lazım, yoktu.
8- Genel olarak temizlik kötüydü, beğenmedik.
9- Bir kaç gün önceden iş planımızın değişmesi sebebi ile sadece 1 gün erken çıkmak istedik ama olumsuz yanıt aldık. Kurallar buysa bilemem ama bir otelde bunu yaşamaz ve 3 bin lira fazladan vermek zorunda kalmazdım.

description: our apartment is 10 minutes walking distance from the historical neighborhood sultanahmahmah. It makes your life easier with its proximity to the cafe,market,taxi station and the covered bazaar around it. You can watch the sea of marmara on our open terrace located on the upper floor.

reviews.text: Very good location, 10 to 20 minutes‘ walk from the Grand Bazar, Blue Mosque, Topkapı Palace, Archeological Museum, Hagia Sophia, Big Bus Tour, Boat Trip, etc. and a lot of places nearby to eat and buy stuff. The place is nice and clean. The owner Mehmet is very friendly and helpful (if you need anything). We were during Christmas and it was warm, no need to use the heater. Quiet quarter which makes sleeping very well. Only WiFi gets evennings very slow, it takes very long to upload the pictures you made during the day online. For this price Mehmet‘s apartment is recommendable. A good option with a reasonable price. We had a great time. Thumbs up ;)

Well, location is good but it is very difficult because of the inclinations of the neighbourhood which wasnt stated earlier. Host wasn’t good dealing with us, the AC wasn’t working for the whole and he kept ignoring us. Difficult stairs to access and no elevators not; good for elderly people. Cleanliness is an issue since there is hair on the edges of the beds and the floor was sticky. Host was a bit of rude. Beds were really uncomfy. Overall, very dissatisfied!

Cosy little place very near to all the main landmarks of the Golden Horn. Mehmet was very swift to accommodate all our requests, and provided us with plenty of local tips to go around. The place was super comfy and clean, with enough space to sleep for 4 people and very good quality bed linen. Air cons in both rooms, clean and spacious bathroom. Parking is a bit tricky as this is the heart of the Old Town, but make your rounds and you will find a free spot or else Mehmet will show you an "Otopark" (usually an empty spot on the place of a demolished house where temporary parking is provided) with very affordable prices. Try freshly squeezed pomegranate juice around the corner for 3 Turkish Lira (it's 10-15 lira elsewhere)! Enthusiastically recommend!

The apartment was well prepared (bed sheets, towels, some kitchen equipments, washing machine, microwave .. etc), very clean and the location is great. People there are very nice and helpful. Great stay!

The apartment is located a few blocks from almost every interesting place in Estambul as Gran Bazar, Blue Mosque. You can arrive in taxi or metro from the airport and the apartment is 3-4 bocks from tram station. The apartment is no so stylish but us comfortable, clean and with central heating (but internet connection is no so good)

description: Welcome to Sunway Bosphorus Suite 3, your urban retreat with a glimpse of the Bosphorus. From your window, marvel in Istanbul's skyline while taking in the suite's plush decor. Suite 3 is the ideal starting point for seeing the city because of its fantastic position close to popular sites including Galataport and Historical Peninsula. Suite 3 offers a distinctive fusion of city views and luxury living thanks to its stylish décor, contemporary facilities, and welcoming ambiance.

reviews.text:
The place has its pros&cons. The price was nice and the view to Bosphorus too. The bed and mattress were really comfortable. However, the photos looked way better than the reality. However, host answered and reacted very fast.
In addition couple of important details about location. Just in front of the window there is a mosque, and yes, it means that you gonna wake up every day at 5 am, so better take earplugs. Also keep in mind that there is a huge stairs for reaching the place, so if you have big suitcases or not very active family members it will be quite difficult

Harun is a really nice host, he brought us water when we first arrived, helped us get an airport transfer, and was always very responsive with anything we needed. He also let our friend stay on the couch and gave us fresh towels and sheets. Apartment is clean, the location is great, really close to the T2. There's a lot of stairs though so be prepared.

The accomodation matches the photos, except for a few minor defects that can be easily fixed. The location is excellent for those who need to be near the new waterfront, but make sure you're in good physical shape, as the house is accessed via a steep staircase. Harun was very supportive and immediately attended to our requests. As a result, we enjoyed our stay at these apartments and would recommend them to other travelers.

Tek kelime harika. Konum müthiş civardaki yerlerle fiyat performans olarak kıyaslanmaz bile. Ev tertemiz. Merdivenler abartıldığı kadar çok ve yüksek değil. Harun bey çok yardımcı ve anında yanıt veren biri bu kadar hızlı bir ev sahibi ile daha önce karşılaşmamıştım. Her şey için teşekkürler bir daha ki ziyaretimizde muhakkak burayı tercih edeceğiz.

We really liked the location of the apartment - close to Galataport, Taksim, and major transport connections. The stairs weren’t a problem for us at all.
Harun sent clear instructions in advance and was always available to answer any questions. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and quiet at night.
Thank you, Harun! Absolutely recommended for a short stay!

description:
Our room is luxurious, modern and carefully designed. Located in our hotel, this room has a large double bed, a 43-inch smart television and a private bathroom. Our room has a small kitchen with a mini fridge and small kitchen supplies.
Our room is on the 1st floor. There is a 24/7 camera and security system. The building's exterior door is specially coded and protected. Our room is designed to accommodate 2 people.

reviews.text: Hey before booking this room I did a lot of research and was looking for more then 2 weeks and I could not have been happier with my decision this was genuinely a wonderful and amazing experience for the price I paid per night I was amazed at the location and aesthetic of the room!! The room is exactly like the pictures it’s beautiful very cozy cute and fun the location is in the middle of a beautiful area we were literally just a 2 min walk to the water front where we just listened to live music ate and enjoyed the view of the Bosphorus honestly my favorite part of the stay!!! Every restaurant cafe is within walking distance! And a SPECIAL thank you to the host for being so Patient and kind and helpful through all my questions!! She was amazing I even lost the room key and she was so fast to get us in the room and give us a spare and was so nice about it!! Any question I had she responded super fast and quickly communication was fantastic service room location everything was wonderful

Great location - convenient for buses, ferries and to get to the Ortakoy Mosque for early and late photoshoots. You can take the ferry to Eminonu easily, or to Emirgan Park for the tulips. There's a grocery store just next door. I arrived quite early in Istanbul and the host was kind enough to let me check-in earlier. The room is spacious and as described with quality furniture, sheets, towels, locks, and you can use the washer and dryer in the basement. Great place to stay in Ortakoy!
The host really friendly and responsive. The place as the photos and the location is near to good places as restaurants cafes and other things.

I had a great stay at this Airbnb in Ortaköy! The apartment was exactly as described and matched the photos perfectly. The host was very proactive, communicative, and flexible, especially with the check-in process, which made everything smooth. They even allowed us to leave our luggage at the reception after checkout since we had a late flight—super helpful!
A couple of tips for future guests: I recommend bringing an eye mask as the curtains don’t fully block out the street lights, and earplugs if you’re a light sleeper, as you might hear some noise from neighbors.

I enjoyed my stay here. I sometimes do not pay close attention when I am booking places, and It sort of failed to register with me that this s actually a small boutique hotel. The staff were great! I had huge delays leaving Tirana at the airport and didn’t get in till after 2:00AM. The host came and let me in not problem. The place is a bit removed from the main tourist areas, but everything is accessible easily. The cafe around the corner is owned by a lovely couple, and the restaurant that is right downstairs is very good. Next to that restaurant is a supermarket. I absolutely recommend it 👍

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
Title: A Perfect Home Away from Home Rating: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I recently had the pleasure of staying in this fantastic apartment, and I cannot sing its praises enough. From the moment I walked through the door, I felt like I had found my own little slice of paradise. The attention to detail in the apartment's is impeccable. The interior is comfortable. The living space is thoughtfully arranged, creating a cozy atmosphere that invites you to relax and unwind.
The kitchen is well-equipped with high-quality appliances and utensils, making meal preparation a joy. The thoughtful touches, such as a welcome coffee, added a personal and welcoming touch to the experience.The cleanliness of the apartment was impeccable.The location of the apartment is also worth mentioning. Conveniently situated near local attractions, restaurants, and public transportation, it made exploring the city a breeze. The hosts were incredibly accommodating. In conclusion, my stay in this apartment was perfect

A really lovely apartment, with nice furniture, a really comfortable bed, very nice kitchen, shower room and bathroom (although I should mention that there was a funky smell there sometimes, from the drain maybe?..), all the amenities, satellite TV, etc.
Really good area, quiet but just 5 minutes on foot into the heart of Beşiktaş nighife area and the docks, with several supermarkets and convenience stores a stone's throw away.
Cengiz was great. I want to recommend him highly, because he was always responsive and friendly. When I needed help, he was great and appeared quickly, with a smile. I'd definitely stay at his place again.
Ev oldukça temiz ve genişti. Akaretler’e ve Beşiktaş’a çok çok yakındı bu harikaydı 🙂 ilgili ve iletişim konusunda Cengiz bey gayet başarılıydı. Tavsiye ederim.

Cengiz bey cok iyi ve saygili bir ev sahibiydi. Bunun disinda evin konumu ve buyuklugu harikaydi. Ev tertemiz ve duzenliydi, mutfak ve banyoda ihtiyaciniz olabilecek seyler fazla fazla vardi. Cengiz beye nazik ve saygılı tavirlari ve guzel bir konaklama deneyimi sundugu icin tesekkur ederim.

A few minutes walking distance to many restaurants, bars and venues. The house was very clean and tidy. Mr. Cengiz was very interested. I had a wonderful stay experience. I definitely recommend it!
Thanks a lot!

description:
From this central location, you can easily access everything as a group.

Our building is 0 and 1.5 months old, our apartments are fully furnished and equipped with luxury materials, the metro and metrobus are 3 minutes away, my apartments are very decent and clean, the building is monitored 24/7 with cameras
We have 2 parking lots, one indoor and one outdoor, for our buildings

reviews.text: "Mohammad is a reliable and responsible host who promptly attends to any issues that arise. The apartment is ideally located, with a short 10-15 minute commute to Sisli and 15 minutes to Zorlu shopping. There are also convenient markets and restaurants in the vicinity. The house itself is clean and appears to be newly built. The only minor issue I encountered during my stay was occasional inconsistency with the water heater, which Mohammad promptly addressed upon notification. Overall, I had a very satisfying experience during my stay.

Tertemiz pirilpiril bir Residans, resimlerdekinnen esittir. Hersey yepyeni yeni temiz havlular baddaniyeler, hijyeni cok iyi, internetleride cok hizli, Konumuda mükemmel, Cevahir Alisverisine yürüyerek 10 dakika. Arabanizi park edicek acik otoparklarida mevcut. Muhammed bey cok misafirperver ve herseye aninda yardimci oluyor. Biz cok memnun kaldik cok tavsiye ederiz ve birdahaki sefere tekrardan gelmeyi düsünüyoruz.

Kendimi evimde ki gibi rahat hissettiğim bir yer oldu herşey özenli ve temizdi.konaklamamızı uzattık ve memnun kaldık.ev sahibimiz can bey oldukça ilgili davrandı her sorumuza yanıt verdi ve hızlı çözümler üretti.tek kelime ile harikaydı teşekkürler herşey için
Her şey için teşekkürler. Konumu ana caddeye çok yakın ve temizliği iyi bir evdi. Muhammed Bey sorularımızı hızlı bir şekilde cevapladı ve yardımcı oldu. Oda kokusuna bayıldık:)
Her şeyiyle inanılmaz güzel bir ev temizliği evin düzeni tek kelimeyle muhteşem.Muhammed beyde çok ilgiliydi girişimden çıkışıma kadar her şeyle ilgilendi.Gönül rahatlığıyla kalabilirsiniz 👋

description:
Spacious 2-bedroom apartment. Two separate bedrooms, large living room, full kitchen, washing machine, A/C, 50" TV and fast Wi-Fi. Sleeps up to 4.
Esenyurt residence. 10 min to Marmara Park Mall, 5 min to E5, 4-8 min to Metrobüs. Free parking. Travel cot on request.

reviews.text:
The unit was mostly what we expected for the price, simple but functional enough for our stay. The main issue was the very strong cigarette smell throughout the apartment, especially in the bedsheets, sofa covers, and curtains. As non-smokers, we found this quite unpleasant, though smoking is allowed so it may not bother everyone.
The condo complex was also under renovation, with many empty blocks, which made the atmosphere feel a bit strange, although there was no major noise or safety issue.
We had a couple of minor issues, including the water stopping once, but the host was always responsive and helpful. Communication was excellent overall, and they kindly allowed early check-in and late checkout.

We had a wonderful two-week stay at Ky‘s place! The house was clean, well-maintained, and equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The kitchen was fully stocked, the bed was cozy, and the living space was perfect for relaxing after a long day. The location couldn’t be better—it’s just a short walk from both the metro and bus stations, making it incredibly convenient to explore the city.
The only thing we wish we had known beforehand is that the house is located on a lower (-1) story, so it lacked a bit of natural sunlight. However, the overall experience was still excellent, and we would highly recommend it to others looking for a comfortable, well-appointed place in a perfect location for getting around in Istanbul! Thank you very much Ky! :)
